jobs.description:
CRM Integration Architect - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: CRM Integration Architect
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking a CRM Integration Architect to design and govern integrations between Salesforce and the broader enterprise application landscape. The role focuses on integration architecture, middleware selection, API strategy, and event-driven patterns that connect Salesforce reliably with ERP, data, marketing, and operational systems. The ideal candidate has architected Salesforce integration solutions at meaningful scale and brings deep familiarity with both Salesforce-native and enterprise middleware approaches. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Key Responsibilities
  • Define the end-to-end integration architecture for Salesforce ecosystems spanning Sales, Service, Marketing, and Industry Clouds.
  • Select and apply appropriate integration patterns including request-reply, fire-and-forget, batch, and event-driven approaches.
  • Design integrations using Salesforce-native capabilities (Platform Events, Change Data Capture, Connect, Composite APIs) alongside enterprise middleware such as MuleSoft, Boomi, or Informatica.
  • Lead integration design reviews and approve technical designs across Salesforce programs.
  • Define API strategy, contract management, and versioning standards for Salesforce-related integrations.
  • Architect data synchronization patterns for high-volume integrations with ERP, billing, and operational systems.
  • Design identity and access patterns for Salesforce integrations including OAuth flows and connected app management.
  • Establish error handling, retry, and dead-letter strategies that ensure reliable integration operations.
  • Drive performance, scalability, and governor-limit management for integration-heavy Salesforce implementations, designing patterns that stay safely within platform limits even as transaction volumes grow over time.
  • Collaborate with security teams to ensure integrations meet enterprise security requirements.
  • Mentor and coach junior and mid-level engineers through code review, design review, pair programming, and structured knowledge sharing, helping the broader team grow in technical maturity and confidence over time.
  • Produce high-quality architecture artifacts — context diagrams, sequence diagrams, decision records, and reference designs — that capture key technical decisions clearly enough to be understood months or years later.
  • Collaborate closely with vendors to evaluate and onboard integration platforms, gathering requirements, aligning on technical approach, and ensuring that delivered solutions meet both functional needs and broader engineering and operational standards.
  • Stay current with Salesforce integration capabilities and broader iPaaS evolution.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • Eight or more years of Salesforce experience, with significant time on complex integrations.
  • Deep understanding of Salesforce APIs, Platform Events, and Change Data Capture.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one major iPaaS such as MuleSoft, Boomi, or Informatica.
  • Strong understanding of integration patterns and enterprise application architecture.
  • Experience designing data synchronization strategies with ERP and operational systems.
  • Strong understanding of identity, OAuth, and integration security.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Salesforce Certified Integration Architect credential.
  • Track record of leading large Salesforce integration programs.
Preferred Qualifications
  • MuleSoft Certified Platform Architect.
  • Experience with event-driven integration platforms (Kafka, Solace, Confluent).
  • Familiarity with Industry Clouds and their data-integration nuances.
  • Exposure to high-volume integration scenarios (10M+ records/day).
  • Experience integrating Salesforce with SAP, Oracle, or NetSuite ERP systems.
How to Apply

jobs.title: Tier 2 Technical Support Agent (UK)
jobs.excerpt: WHO WE AREHapana powers some of the world's leading fitness brands.
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Hapana powers some of the world's leading fitness brands. Walk into Fitstop, STRONG Pilates, KX Pilates, Gold's Gym or J.I.M and there's a good chance our platform is running the entire business—from memberships and bookings to payments, marketing and growth.

The fitness industry is evolving rapidly, and we're the technology helping drive that transformation.

Today we're a team of 115 people across Australia, USA, UK, Brazil, Singapore and India, building products that thousands of fitness businesses rely on every day. Everything we create has a direct impact on real customers, real businesses and millions of member experiences around the world.

We're entering an exciting new chapter as we invest heavily in our platform, AI capabilities and product innovation. If you're passionate about solving meaningful problems, working with talented people and shipping products that customers love, we'd love to meet you.

THE OPPORTUNITY

As a Tier 2 Technical Support Agent, you'll be the technical backbone of our support team, the person others turn to when an issue needs a deeper level of expertise. You'll take ownership of the most complex support tickets across all Hapana product lines, working through problems that span APIs, webhooks, authentication, CRM integrations and payment processing.

This role sits at the intersection of support, product and engineering. You'll work closely with our Development, Product and Onboarding teams to validate technical requirements, unblock customers and make sure every stakeholder has accurate, timely information. You'll also help shape the way our support function operates, spotting opportunities to improve processes and building the knowledge base that helps the whole team work smarter.

Most importantly, you'll bring a level head and sharp problem solving to every ticket, protecting the client experience even when the issue in front of you is anything but simple.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Ticket Ownership & Resolution: Manage a high volume of Tier 2 support tickets, resolving complex technical issues, escalating where needed and meeting SLA requirements while maintaining accuracy under pressure.
  • Technical Expertise: Serve as the team's subject matter expert on web development concepts including APIs, webhooks and authentication, and build deep working knowledge of CRM systems, particularly GoHighLevel.
  • Stripe & Payments Support: Troubleshoot payment processing, billing concerns and verification issues, escalating unresolved cases and keeping customers informed throughout resolution.
  • Process & Knowledge Base Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve support processes, create knowledge base articles and videos, and coordinate support-related data tasks.
  • Cross-Functional Liaison: Build strong relationships with CSMs, Development, Product, Onboarding and Sales, validating technical requirements and making sure every stakeholder has accurate information.
  • Autonomous Judgement: Work effectively under pressure, both independently and with supervision, maintaining a high level of accuracy across a demanding ticket queue.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

We're looking for someone who's naturally curious, technically sharp and genuinely enjoys solving problems for people. You'll ideally bring:

  • Experience in technical support or a Tier 2 support role, preferably within SaaS or software environments.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Familiarity with APIs, webhooks and basic web development concepts.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex technical issues for a non-technical audience.
  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience with Stripe or other payment processors is a plus.
  • Basic experience with CRM platforms is highly advantageous.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across multiple departments.
  • Ability to work on weekends, with two rostered days off (RDOs) during the week.

If you're reading this thinking, “I don't tick every single box, but this sounds like me,” we'd still love to hear from you. We hire for potential as much as experience.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

By the end of your first year, you'll have:

  • Become the go-to technical expert for complex, escalated support issues.
  • Consistently met SLA and accuracy targets across a high-volume ticket queue.
  • Built trusted working relationships across CSMs, Development, Product, Onboarding and Sales.
  • Strengthened our knowledge base with articles and videos that reduce repeat escalations.
  • Deepened your expertise in GoHighLevel, Stripe and Hapana's broader technical ecosystem.
  • Helped shape stronger, smarter support processes for the wider team.

LIFE AT HAPANA

We believe great work happens when people are trusted, supported and given room to do their best work. What you'll enjoy:

  • Birthday Leave – Take your birthday off, on us.
  • Wellness Days – Two additional wellbeing days each year, separate from annual leave.
  • Work From Anywhere – Spend up to two weeks each year working from anywhere in the world.
  • Home Office Allowance – Create a workspace you'll genuinely enjoy.
  • Paid Parental Leave – Supporting both primary and secondary carers.

JOIN US

We're building products that power the future of fitness and we're only just getting started.

If you love solving meaningful problems, collaborating with exceptional people and seeing your work make a genuine impact, we'd love to hear from you.

Hapana is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work. Different perspectives make us stronger, and they're one of the reasons we've come this far—and will continue to grow.

We're excited to manage this recruitment ourselves, so we won't be partnering with recruitment agencies for this opportunity.

Salary: £43,000 per annum

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

Job Title: Enterprise Data Architect
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking a Enterprise Data Architect to define and lead the architecture of our enterprise data platform, spanning ingestion, storage, processing, governance, and consumption layers. The role drives the strategic direction of data infrastructure, sets standards for data modeling and lifecycle management, and partners with data engineering, analytics, ML, and business stakeholders to deliver a coherent, scalable data foundation. The ideal candidate combines deep technical mastery of modern data platforms with strong architectural judgment, and has led data-platform programs of meaningful scope and complexity.

Key Responsibilities
  • Define the target-state architecture of the enterprise data platform, including ingestion, storage, processing, and consumption layers.
  • Establish standards for data modeling, schema evolution, partitioning, file formats, and storage organization.
  • Architect lakehouse, warehouse, and streaming patterns leveraging technologies such as Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift, Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Hudi.
  • Design end-to-end data pipelines that balance latency, cost, reliability, and maintainability across batch and streaming workloads.
  • Lead the integration of governance, lineage, and catalog tools such as Collibra, Alation, Atlan, Unity Catalog, or DataHub.
  • Define security architecture including row- and column-level controls, masking, encryption, and identity-aware access patterns.
  • Partner with ML, BI, and product teams to ensure platform capabilities align with downstream consumption needs.
  • Establish data contract and data product principles to drive ownership, quality, and decoupling between producers and consumers.
  • Lead architecture reviews and provide guidance on pipeline and warehouse design proposals across teams.
  • Drive cost optimization and capacity planning across the data platform estate.
  • Design disaster recovery, multi-region, and high-availability strategies for critical data assets.
  • Mentor data engineers and architects on platform standards and emerging best practices.
  • Produce architecture artifacts including context diagrams, decision records, and reference patterns.
  • Stay current with data platform research, vendor offerings, and open-source ecosystem developments.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Eight or more years of experience in data engineering, with significant time in architecture roles.
  • Deep expertise across at least two major data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, or Redshift.
  • Strong understanding of lakehouse architectures, modern table formats, and streaming systems.
  • Hands-on experience with Spark, Flink, or Kafka at production scale.
  • Strong data modeling expertise across dimensional, normalized, and data-vault patterns.
  • Experience implementing governance, lineage, and catalog capabilities.
  • Solid grasp of cloud platforms, networking, identity, and cost optimization.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Track record of leading large data platform initiatives across teams.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with data mesh or data product architectures.
  • Familiarity with semantic layers such as dbt Semantic Layer, Cube, or LookML.
  • Exposure to regulated industries with strict data residency or audit requirements.
  • Cloud or platform certifications (Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Public talks or writing on data architecture.

Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.


In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.


Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.

Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).

jobs.title: Manager, Market & Network Planning
jobs.excerpt: About AccelecomAccelecom is a leading provider of high-speed fiber optic network solutions, delivering reliable, high-performance connectivity to enterprise, government, and industrial customers across Georgia, Kentucky, and the broader Southeast.
jobs.description:
About Accelecom

Accelecom is a leading provider of high-speed fiber optic network solutions, delivering reliable, high-performance connectivity to enterprise, government, and industrial customers across Georgia, Kentucky, and the broader Southeast. We build and operate the fiber — and we decide where to build it next based on hard market intelligence. That’s where this role comes in.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Manager, Market & Network Planning to determine where our fiber network should grow next — and to build the market intelligence behind those decisions. You’ll pair outside-plant (OSP) network planning — fiber routes, build-versus-buy, and capacity — with market planning: sizing the total addressable market (TAM), assessing competitive density, mapping which providers serve each street today, and understanding what they offer and charge. It’s an analytical, high-visibility role for someone who has planned, built, or competed in carrier networks.

Read This First

This is a telecom carrier planning role — not an IT role.

This position is not a corporate/enterprise IT, help-desk, system administration, cloud, cybersecurity, or enterprise network-engineering role. Here, “network” means a service-provider outside-plant fiber network — feeder and distribution routes, homes and businesses passed, serviceable addresses — not LAN/WAN, routers and switches, or datacenter/cloud infrastructure. We’re specifically seeking candidates from telecommunications carriers and service providers — LEC, CLEC, ISP, or MSO. If your experience is primarily in corporate/enterprise IT, this role will not be a match.

Requirements

Market Planning

  • Perform geo-market assessments to size the total addressable market (TAM) and evaluate competitive density across target areas.
  • Build TAM analysis spanning both brownfield and greenfield customer prospects (businesses and locations).
  • Determine which carriers and service providers are serving each target at the street level.
  • Capture competitors’ current offerings and pricing to inform positioning and go/no-go decisions.
  • Create and manage pro forma financial models that weigh the cost to build into a market against the implied revenue from its TAM over time, and the resulting return on investment (ROI).
  • Translate market and competitive intelligence into a prioritized network-expansion opportunity pipeline.

Network Planning

  • Plan and design fiber network expansion — routes, feeder and distribution — for greenfield and brownfield builds.
  • Drive build-versus-buy decisions using IRU/lease economics and construction cost.
  • Support IRU and off-net (Type 2) arrangements across their life cycle.
  • Maintain a full dashboard tracking all IRU and colocation (Colo) contracts, plus forward-looking financials.
  • Perform capacity analysis and forecasting to stay ahead of demand.
  • Keep designs and market data current and accurate in fiber GIS/planning tools such as 3GIS.

What You Bring

  • Telecom carrier / service provider experience (LEC, CLEC, ISP, or MSO) in network and/or market planning — this is required; enterprise IT experience alone will not qualify.
  • Working knowledge of outside-plant (OSP) fiber networks: routes, feeder/distribution, and serviceability.
  • Experience with market sizing / TAM, competitive density, or street-level serviceability and pricing analysis.
  • Understanding of build-versus-buy economics, IRU/leasing, and carrier interconnection.
  • Strong analytical and data skills across GIS and spreadsheet/market data, with the ability to turn analysis into clear recommendations.
  • 5+ years in telecom network and/or market planning.

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on experience with 3GIS, Connected2Fiber, ArcGIS, or similar fiber GIS / market-intelligence platforms.
  • Familiarity with FTTX, DWDM, and access/transport technologies.
  • Knowledge of the southeastern U.S. fiber and carrier landscape.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field, or equivalent telecom experience and/or industry certifications.

Highlights

This position is not a corporate/enterprise IT, help-desk, system administration, cloud, cybersecurity, or enterprise network-engineering role.

The client is a US-based serial entrepreneur, YPO member, and CEO sitting above an expansive global portfolio of ~7 distinct businesses comprising a total team of 200+ individuals.

The portfolio spans several industries, including:

  • Direct-Response Marketing & Data: High-volume lead generation and data solutions.
  • Global BPO Operations: A 250-seat contact center.
  • Direct-to-Consumer Services: D2C automotive warranty operations supported by a 40-person team.
  • Specialized Holdings: Additional ventures across B2B and B2C sectors.

The CEO operates purely at the executive level above dedicated operators in each business. He moves fast, values direct communication, and leans heavily into modern technology and AI to drive performance across his enterprises.

About the Role:

We are seeking an exceptionally sharp, proactive, and high-energy Executive Assistant (EA) to serve as the strategic central hub for our CEO across four primary operating businesses (spanning an umbrella of portfolio entities across the US, Latin America, and South Africa).

In this role, you will be the ultimate gatekeeper, operational anchor, and execution force. The CEO operates at high speed, manages multiple moving entities, and relies heavily on direct delegation. Your core mission is to filter out the daily noise, manage high-level scheduling and CRM reporting, rebuild and maintain organizational SOPs, leverage AI workflows, and keep the CEO organized and focused purely on top-level business development and strategy.

Key Responsibilities

1. Executive Gatekeeping & Calendar Management

  • Central Traffic Control: Act as the primary filter across all 4 core operating businesses and global teams (US, LATAM, South Africa), managing direct-line access to the CEO with diplomacy, warmth, and tact.
  • Calendar & Meeting Safety Net: Actively manage and de-conflict multiple overlapping calendars. Provide proactive reminders (e.g., 10-minute warning alerts) to eliminate missed meetings.
  • Delegation Tracking: Capture rapid directives, voice memos, and quick calls, translating them into tracked tasks and following up across teams to ensure zero items fall through the cracks.

2. CRM Data Entry, Metrics & Reporting

  • Executive Data Entry: Act as the direct data entry conduit for the CEO, logging executive notes, leads, and follow-ups into CRMs (GoHighLevel and in-house proprietary software).
  • Metric Dashboards: Pull daily/weekly high-level stats (sales metrics, direct-response marketing performance, lead generation stats, conversion rates) and prepare clean summary reports so the CEO has real-time visibility without having to log in manually.

3. SOP Ownership & AI Workflow Integration

  • SOP Maintenance: Take full ownership of auditing, drafting, updating, and organizing Standard Operating Procedures across all positions and organizations.
  • AI Workflows & Automation: Leverage modern AI productivity tools (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) and collaborate with internal technical teams building autonomous AI agents for call/email workflows to streamline routine tasks.
  • Digital Admin: Handle routine domain setups, basic email configurations, and light website edits as needed.

4. Travel & Personal Logistics

  • Travel Coordination: Plan and manage complex domestic and international travel, detailed itineraries, and loyalty programs.
  • Expense Management: Manage personal expenses and administrative purchases securely via virtual credit card platforms (e.g., Ramp, Brex, Relay). (Note: Core business finances are handled separately by our Controller and CFO).
  • Life Admin: Coordinate ad-hoc personal logistics, bookings, and executive errands.

Candidate Profile & Non-Negotiables

Must-Haves (Non-Negotiable)

  • Bilingual Proficiency: Fully fluent in both English and Spanish (written and spoken) to seamlessly bridge operations across US and Latin American teams.
  • Proactive Ownership & Curiosity: A self-motivated mindset. You don't just mechanically execute tasks; you seek to understand the "why" behind directives, anticipate upcoming needs, and resolve issues independently.
  • High Emotional Intelligence (EQ): Exceptional communication skills and tact when stepping into internal workflows, insulating the CEO while maintaining positive, collaborative relationships across teams.
  • Hyper-Organized Safety Net: Thrives in a fast-paced environment and acts as an operational anchor for an executive with high delegation demands.

Nice-to-Haves (Preferred Experience)

  • Marketing & Call Center Background: Familiarity with direct-response marketing, agency workflows, lead generation metrics (CPL, ad spend), or call center environments.
  • Financial Literacy: Basic understanding of business accounting (ability to read and interpret P&L statements and balance sheets).
  • AI & CRM Aptitude: Prior experience using GoHighLevel (or similar CRMs) and enthusiasm for AI automation tools.

jobs.excerpt: Portless is changing the face of global e-commerce.
jobs.description:
Portless is changing the face of global e-commerce. By decoupling brands from traditional, expensive domestic warehousing, we allow e-commerce companies to ship directly from manufacturing hubs to global consumers in as little as 3-5 days. We are growing fast, and we are looking for an elite, full-stack engineer to help us scale a world-class, globally distributed platform to power the future of cross-border logistics.

The Role

We are looking for a high-leverage, senior full-stack operator to own and scale major pillars of our global supply chain orchestration platform. In this role, you aren’t just taking tickets and writing code; you will own entire architectural modules from end-to-end.

You will build out our B2B merchant portal, optimize our core logistics engine, and design heavy-duty API integrations connecting Portless to major Order, Warehouse, and Transportation Management Systems (OMS/WMS/TMS). This is a role for a highly autonomous, deeply curious engineer who thrives in an asynchronous, remote environment and loves solving the messy, complex problems that happen when software meets the physical world.

The Tech Stack

We build on a modern, fully serverless, cloud-native, and event-driven architecture.

  • Backend & Infrastructure: Node.js, Express, TypeScript, Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Databases & Analytics: Cloud SQL / PostgreSQL, Firestore, ClickHouse, BigQuery.
  • Frontend: React, Vite.js, TypeScript.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the Solution: Take broad, high-level product requirements and turn them into production-ready features. You will be responsible for the full lifecycle of your code—from schema design to slick, intuitive frontend experiences.
  • Build Resilient Core Infrastructure: Architect and develop critical modules that coordinate international shipping routes, customs data, and real-time package tracking. Because global supply chains never sleep, you will design these workflows to be highly fault-tolerant and resilient to external network errors.
  • Deep Integration Work: Build and maintain heavy-duty API integrations with enterprise OMS, WMS, and TMS platforms. You will implement robust retry strategies, idempotency keys, and dead-letter queues to handle the chaotic nature of physical-world data synchronization.
  • Drive Asynchronous Momentum: Work seamlessly across a globally distributed team (USA, Canada, EU, UK, China). You write clear documentation, communicate proactively in public channels, and don't need real-time meetings to make meaningful progress.
  • Maintain High Engineering Standards: Participate in rigorous asynchronous code reviews. Help us maintain elite DORA metrics by ensuring your code is modular, heavily tested, and highly observable so we can keep our Change Failure Rate low.

What We’re Looking For

  • The Self-Driving Engineer: 5+ years of professional full-stack experience (TypeScript / Node.js / React), ideally in a fast-paced, high-growth startup environment. You are entirely comfortable with ambiguity, know how to unblock yourself, take extreme pride in ownership, and demonstrate a clear mindset for owning the solution from conception to deployment.
  • AI Fluency: You are a power user of modern AI development tools (e.g., Cursor, Copilot, Claude Code) and treat them as an extension of your own capability. You leverage AI throughout the entire lifecycle—not just for coding, but for discovery, architectural setup, and complex solution design. You bring a 'product owner' mindset to your AI usage: you are detail-oriented, maintain a big-picture view, and know how to direct AI to solve business-critical problems, while always maintaining a sharp human eye to catch hallucinations or architectural drift.
  • Distributed Systems Mindset: Proven track record building cloud-native, event-driven architectures. You have deep experience designing fault-tolerant systems and know how to handle race conditions, eventual consistency, split-brain scenarios, and flaky third-party APIs.
  • Data & Storage Pragmatism: You understand when to use a relational database (PostgreSQL), when to leverage NoSQL/document stores (Firestore), and how to work alongside real-time analytical engines (ClickHouse) or deep data warehouses (BigQuery).
  • Deep Curiosity & Attention to Detail: You don't just paste together answers or accept "it works" on the surface. You go deep into the stack to understand why something breaks, obsess over edge cases, and think about how your code behaves at scale.
  • Distributed Native & Team Player: Proven experience working effectively in a globally distributed, asynchronous environment. You excel at written communication, keep projects moving across time zones, and naturally serve as a collaborative team player. You proactively assist others without being prompted, identifying opportunities to support the team’s success, and always prioritize shared wins over individual recognition.

Bonus Points (Nice-to-Haves)

  • Deep experience with the GCP / Firebase ecosystem (especially Firestore and Data Connect at scale).
  • Direct experience building systems in Logistics, Supply Chain, FinTech, or E-commerce verticals.
  • Previous experience integrating with enterprise e-commerce platforms (Shopify, WooCommerce) or global shipping/carrier APIs.

Why Portless?

  • Competitive salary + meaningful equity package.
  • Flexible, remote-first, and asynchronous-friendly work environment across multiple time zones.
  • The chance to solve massive, tangible global trade problems alongside a highly focused, elite engineering team.

jobs.description:
About Atria:

The Atria Health Institute is a membership-based primary and specialty health care practice with a focus on prevention and longevity. We bring together a multidisciplinary team of renowned physicians to provide proactive, preventive, and precision-based care for Atria members and their families. All care, including primary care, advanced screening and diagnostics, urgent care, specialty care, 24/7 home visits, and imaging is included in members’ annual fee.

Our mission is to make healthspan and lifespan equal for all by translating science into medicine in real-time, all while bringing humanity back into health care. Delivering such robust, personalized, and preventive health care is complex and requires a team-wide dedication to excellence.

After successfully opening our flagship Institute in New York in 2022 and expanding to South Florida in 2024, we are now bringing the Atria experience to the West Coast with the launch of our Los Angeles Institute in late spring 2026.

Atria Health is seeking a Staff Software Engineer for our Foundations team, working across Platform, DevOps, and Data Engineering.

This is a senior individual contributor role responsible for leading the technical direction of our platform, with a focus on EMR integrations (particularly Athena), systems infrastructure, caching strategies, and robust internal tooling and support for our domain product teams (Clinical Experience, Member Experience, and Care Delivery). You'll own the design and implementation of core platform services while acting as a force multiplier for engineering across the organization.

You'll partner closely with engineers and clinical leaders to turn ambiguous problems into clear technical strategies, ensure architectural consistency across teams, and take end-to-end ownership of complex, multi-team initiatives from idea to launch. From defining solutions to ensuring strong monitoring and clean analytics in Mixpanel, you'll care deeply about both how we build and what we achieve.

Tech Stack

  • Languages: TypeScript
  • Backend: Node.js, Express
  • Frontend: React, Honeypot SDK
  • Infrastructure: Google Cloud Platform, Terraform
  • Databases: MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis
  • Integrations: Athena EMR, wearable platforms, third-party healthcare APIs
  • Tooling: GitHub, Sentry, Okta, Mixpanel, Omni

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Architecture

  • Partner with the Sr. Director, Foundations to define and drive the technical vision and direction for the Foundations group.
  • Lead architecture decisions for integration patterns, caching infrastructure, and shared services, and design the APIs, data models, and integration patterns that let teams build new clinical and member experiences without reinventing the wheel.
  • Serve as a technical escalation point for complex platform challenges, and conduct design reviews to ensure services meet reliability, performance, and security standards.
  • Raise the bar on reliability and performance by driving SLOs, capacity planning, and incident-ready designs for the systems you own.
  • Personally execute on the highest-priority and most technically challenging projects, and own end-to-end delivery for complex initiatives that cut across multiple product teams and services.

Application Performance

  • Design and implement strategies that improve application performance and reduce external API dependencies.
  • Build and maintain caching infrastructure with appropriate invalidation patterns.
  • Monitor and optimize platform performance, identifying bottlenecks and implementing improvements.
  • Establish best practices and patterns for product teams to adopt.

Platform & Product Team Enablement

  • Act as a partner to product engineering teams, understanding their needs and providing platform solutions that accelerate development.
  • Build and maintain shared libraries, SDKs, and internal APIs that improve developer productivity.
  • Create documentation, examples, and guidelines for consuming platform services.
  • Provide technical guidance and support during product team integration efforts.

Quality, Observability & Analytics

  • Embed testability in designs: meaningful unit and functional tests, contract tests between services, and automated checks where they matter most.
  • Ensure new features are instrumented with high-quality analytics in Mixpanel, with events and properties that stay consistent across products.
  • Work with Product and Data to set up dashboards and monitoring that reflect real user and clinical outcomes, not just vanity metrics.
  • Drive post-incident reviews and systemic improvements when things break.

Mentorship & Culture

  • Mentor senior and mid-level engineers through design guidance, pairing, and thoughtful code review.
  • Help define and uphold engineering standards: coding conventions, architecture patterns, and documentation norms.
  • Model a pragmatic, product-focused mindset that balances high standards with iterative delivery and experimentation.

Compensation: $200,000 - $280,000 (based on location)

Requirements

Core Experience

  • ~8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with significant time as a senior/staff IC building product experiences in production.
  • A track record of owning and shipping multi-team projects in modern web stacks.
  • Experience working closely with product and design on user-facing features.
  • Comfortable leading technical decisions in ambiguous domains and defending those decisions with clear tradeoffs.

Technical Skills

  • Strong full-stack skills: you can design an API and data model, build the UI that consumes it, and wire up monitoring and metrics.
  • Deep familiarity with at least one cloud provider and infrastructure-as-code.
  • Strong instincts around systems design: reliability, performance, security, and cost all feature in your thinking.
  • Excellent debugging and incident-response skills; you're comfortable digging into logs, traces, and data to understand issues.

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Proven ability to lead through influence: aligning multiple teams and partners on technical direction without needing direct authority.
  • Comfort working in a highly cross-functional environment with clinicians, operations, and research in the loop.
  • Clear written and verbal communication; you can explain complex technical topics to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.
  • You enjoy mentoring and leveling up the people around you.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in healthcare, digital health, or other regulated domains (HIPAA, PHI, SOC 2, etc.).
  • Exposure to EHRs, wearables integrations, or other health data platforms.

Benefits

At Atria, we are proud to offer every member of the Atria team:

  • Excellent health and wellness benefits, fully covered by Atria, effective date of hire
  • OneMedical membership for employees & dependents, giving access to 24/7 virtual care
  • Fertility & family planning
  • Company-covered preventive health screenings through partner hospitals (calcium score)
  • Fitness Perks, including Wellhub +
  • 401k contributions and 4% match starting after 6 months
  • Flexible Time Off
  • Continuing medical education (CME) and CEU support for professional licensure

We are representing a prominent, well-established engineering and consulting firm based in Israel. With over three decades of industry excellence, our client specializes in the design, planning, and management of complex electrical, communications, and control systems for large-scale national infrastructure projects.

Having recently secured major new railway electrification contracts, our client is looking to expand their engineering capabilities. Recognizing Poland’s rich railway heritage, extensive infrastructure network, and top-tier engineering talent, they are launching a strategic initiative to build a dedicated engineering presence based in Poland.

Your Role

As a Railway Electrification Planner, you will initially be working fully remotely, collaborating closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams, project managers, and stakeholders based in Israel to deliver safe, reliable, and efficient electrified railway systems.

You will be our client's first dedicated engineering hire in Poland. While your primary focus will be on hands-on planning and technical design, this role offers significant upward mobility. For the right candidate, as the project portfolio grows and the company expands its local footprint, there is strong potential for this position to evolve into a team leadership or managerial role.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the planning and concept development of railway electrification systems, including 25 kV AC, 15 kV AC, and 750 V DC traction power configurations, in accordance with applicable national and international standards.

  • Develop and review technical documentation including system design reports, load flow studies, short-circuit analyses, protection coordination studies, and earthing & bonding schemes.

  • Plan and specify traction power substations (TPS) and autotransformer stations, including transformer sizing, switchgear configuration, SCADA/remote control interfaces, and protection relay settings.

  • Produce and review drawings, schematics, and layout plans for substation sites and overhead line equipment corridors.

  • Perform or oversee route surveys, corridor studies, and site feasibility assessments for electrification infrastructure.

  • Define technical specifications and tender documentation for electrification works and equipment procurement.

  • Manage interfaces with civil, signalling, telecommunications, and rolling stock disciplines to ensure system compatibility and integration.

  • Support environmental impact assessments and planning approval processes related to electrification infrastructure.

  • Review contractor submittals, shop drawings, and method statements during the design and construction phases.

  • Participate in design reviews, HAZOP/HAZID workshops, and safety assurance processes in line with the applicable Safety Management System (SMS).

  • Monitor industry developments, regulatory changes, and emerging standards relevant to railway electrification.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering.

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in railway electrification planning or design, with demonstrable involvement in traction power substation projects.

  • Solid understanding of traction power supply systems (AC and/or DC), overhead line systems, and power quality requirements.

  • Experience with load flow and short-circuit simulation tools (e.g., PSCAD, ETAP, Spice-based tools, or equivalent).

  • Knowledge of substation protection, SCADA systems, and earthing philosophies for traction environments.

  • Proficiency in AutoCAD and CIVIL 3D.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; additional languages are an asset.

  • Preferred: Eligibility for professional engineering registration (PE, CEng, or national equivalent).

What We Offer

  • 100% Remote Work: Work fully from the comfort of your home anywhere in Poland.

  • Stability: A long-term, full-time B2B contract working on secure, high-profile infrastructure projects.

  • Career Progression: Get in on the ground floor. As the first Polish hire, you will be in a prime position to advance into a management role as the local team scales.

  • International Exposure: Collaborate directly with senior stakeholders and multidisciplinary teams in a booming international infrastructure sector.

jobs.description:
As a Tax Accountant, you will play a key role in supporting the Group Tax Manager and strengthening the organization’s global tax function across a rapidly growing, international business. You will take ownership of day-to-day tax matters and contribute to the delivery of tax compliance, reporting, and planning activities across multiple corporate entities operating in various jurisdictions.

Working closely with the wider finance team and cross-functional stakeholders, you will provide technical tax support, help drive accuracy and efficiency in tax processes, and ensure the business remains compliant with evolving tax regulations and reporting requirements. This role requires a high level of professional judgment, integrity, and accountability in managing sensitive tax and financial information.

You will be expected to demonstrate a proactive and adaptable approach in navigating changing tax legislation, tight deadlines, and shifting business priorities. In addition to supporting compliance and reporting activities, you will contribute to tax risk management, process improvements, and strategic tax initiatives that support the company’s hyper-growth and global expansion.

This is an excellent opportunity for a tax professional who is committed to continuous learning and development, stays current with industry trends and international tax developments, and is looking to make a meaningful impact in a hands-on, fast-paced environment. The role offers broad exposure to a wide range of tax matters and the chance to actively contribute to the evolution of the tax function across a complex global organization.

What you'll be doing

  • Leading the preparation, review, and timely submission of indirect tax returns across multiple jurisdictions, with particular emphasis on US sales and use tax, as well as VAT, OSS VAT, GST/HST, and SST filings for UK and international entities.
  • Taking ownership of the reconciliation and analysis of direct and indirect tax balance sheet accounts, ensuring the accuracy and completeness of tax liabilities, tax accruals, and turnover reconciliations across the group.
  • Overseeing the preparation and posting of monthly and year-end tax journal entries, ensuring tax accounting is accurate, well-documented, and aligned with group reporting requirements.
  • Managing tax filing calendars and coordinating the timely execution of tax payments and statutory filings, ensuring full compliance with local and international deadlines.
  • Preparing and monitoring monthly tax cash flow forecasts, partnering closely with the treasury and finance teams to ensure accurate funding, timely payment of tax liabilities, and effective reconciliation of tax payments.
  • Owning the administration, review, and ongoing optimization of AvaTax and ECM tax processes, including monthly tax submissions, system accuracy, and process improvements related to indirect tax determination and reporting, particularly for US sales tax compliance.
  • Supporting and helping drive the group’s global tax compliance obligations, including US state and local tax requirements, gross receipts tax, annual reports, business licence filings, and other recurring statutory compliance matters across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Partnering with the Group Tax Manager in the management of broader tax obligations, including PSA, STBV reporting, transfer pricing and R&D matters, and other corporate tax compliance and reporting requirements.
  • Acting as a key point of contact for internal stakeholders across finance, legal, treasury, and operations on tax-related matters, providing timely, practical, and commercially focused guidance, particularly in relation to US indirect tax exposure and compliance.
  • Supporting the preparation and coordination of tax documentation required for internal and external audits, ensuring audit readiness and maintaining strong supporting records across all tax processes.
  • Playing an active role in managing tax audits, enquiries, and correspondence with HMRC, US state tax authorities, and other overseas tax authorities, including information gathering, response coordination, and issue tracking.
  • Contributing to tax-related projects, system implementations, business changes, and ad hoc strategic initiatives, bringing a proactive and solutions-oriented approach to complex tax matters.

  • Proven experience in a tax accounting or tax compliance role, with responsibility for managing a broad range of direct and indirect tax matters across multiple entities and jurisdictions.

  • Strong technical knowledge of direct and indirect taxes, with the ability to interpret and apply tax rules in a practical business context, including exposure to US tax compliance, sales tax, and international tax reporting requirements.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage competing deadlines, prioritise effectively, and maintain a high standard of accuracy and judgment in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

  • Proven capability to operate with a high degree of autonomy, taking ownership of tax processes and deliverables while exercising sound professional judgment and escalating issues where appropriate.

  • Strong problem-solving skills, with a proactive mindset and a continuous improvement approach to identifying tax risks, strengthening controls, and improving processes.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build effective relationships and work collaboratively with internal stakeholders, external advisers, auditors, and tax authorities.

  • High level of integrity, professionalism, and discretion when handling sensitive financial and tax information.

  • Strong attention to detail combined with the ability to see the bigger picture and understand the broader commercial and operational impact of tax matters.

Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At The Adaptavist Group, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. Equal opportunities for everyone

At The Adaptavist Group, we are committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive community and believe this positively impacts both the creation of our innovative products and our delivery of bespoke solutions to our global customers and our own unique culture. We encourage all qualified applicants, regardless of age, disability, race, sexual orientation, religion or belief, sex, gender identity, pregnancy and maternity, marriage, and civil partnership status.

We will never ask for any form of payment, fees, or financial commitment at any stage of recruitment, including applications, interviews, onboarding, or equipment provision.

Working at The Adaptavist Group

The Adaptavist Group is a global family of companies with a common goal. We combine the best of teamwork, technology, and processes, helping all kinds of businesses be better today and tomorrow.

We are experts at delivering enterprise software, tailored solutions, and quality services across some of the world’s most trusted technology ecosystems, including Atlassian, AWS, Slack, GitLab, monday.com and Aha!

We make change happen. From anywhere.

jobs.title: SDET / Engineer in Test
jobs.excerpt: We’re modernizing our enterprise integration landscape and are looking for a hands-on SDET / Engineer in Test to build a robust automated regression testing framework for an Event-Driven Architecture (EDA) environment.
jobs.description:
We’re modernizing our enterprise integration landscape and are looking for a hands-on SDET / Engineer in Test to build a robust automated regression testing framework for an Event-Driven Architecture (EDA) environment.

This is not a UI testing role. You will write code to validate asynchronous message flows and integration logic, ensuring regressions are caught automatically on every deployment.

Contract

Contractor / Project-based (extension potential)

Core Tech Stack

Solace PubSub+ (or equivalent broker), Boomi (or MuleSoft/Tibco), Python (preferred) or Node.js, Docker, CI/CD (Jenkins/Azure DevOps), Git

What you will build / own

  • A headless test harness that can act as both Publisher and Subscriber to validate message flows.

  • Automated regression strategies for asynchronous patterns:

    • fire-and-forget

    • request-reply

    • event chaining

  • Test data generation to create complex payloads programmatically and cover edge cases.

  • CI/CD integration so tests run automatically (containerized via Docker) on every deployment.

Key responsibilities

  • Build an automation framework (Python or Node.js) to publish/subscribe and validate end-to-end flows through a message broker.

  • Validate EDA regressions (e.g., messages sent to Topic A produce expected outcomes on Topic B), including:

    • correlation IDs, timeouts, retries, ordering, idempotency

  • Generate JSON test payloads from schemas to cover boundary values, invalid cases, and load scenarios.

  • Containerize tests with Docker and integrate into Jenkins / Azure DevOps pipelines.

  • Troubleshoot failures across distributed systems using logs (e.g., Boomi process logs + broker events) to isolate root causes.

Must-have requirements

  • Strong coding skills in Python (preferred) or Node.js for backend test automation (not Selenium-only).

  • Experience testing APIs and integration flows (integration/system/contract testing).

  • Solid understanding of EDA / PubSub concepts (topics/queues, acknowledgments, retries, correlation IDs, etc.).

  • Experience with Docker, Git, and CI/CD (Jenkins or Azure DevOps).

  • Strong troubleshooting skills in distributed environments (log-driven debugging, root-cause analysis).

Nice to have

  • Hands-on with Solace PubSub+ (or Kafka/RabbitMQ/ActiveMQ).

  • Familiarity with Boomi (or MuleSoft/Tibco).

  • Experience building testing tooling for asynchronous/event-driven systems.

  • Comfortable using AI coding assistants (Copilot, etc.) for accelerating boilerplate/test-data generation.

jobs.title: Information Security Architect
jobs.excerpt: At Unit4, we’re in Business for People.  The Global Security organisation protects our people, platforms, products, and customers by driving secure design, resilience, and maturity across the entire business.
jobs.description:
At Unit4, we’re in Business for People. The Global Security organisation protects our people, platforms, products, and customers by driving secure design, resilience, and maturity across the entire business. As we strengthen our architecture capability across CISO, IT, and CloudOps, we are seeking an experienced Security Architect to partner across the enterprise and help shape Unit4’s future‑state security landscape.

This role sits within the CISO Security Team but works with Product/Engineering, Enterprise Architecture and CloudOps. You will play a pivotal role in designing, governing, and embedding secure architectural principles across Unit4’s technology estate.

Job Description

The Security Architect will develop, and mature Unit4’s enterprise security architecture across cloud, infrastructure, identity, SaaS, and endpoint domains. You will collaborate with senior stakeholders, guide teams, and translate business strategy and risk into secure, scalable, and pragmatic designs.

This is a hands‑on architectural role for someone who thrives in complex environments, can operate strategically and tactically, and who brings expertise across security architecture, cloud, and modern enterprise platforms.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Security Architecture

  • Lead the security target state architecture and multi-year roadmap, aligning risk reduction and business outcomes; socialize tradeoffs with leadership.
  • Lead enterprise architecture assessments across multiple environments, including:
    • Cloud (Azure) security and network infrastructure, including Kubernetes
    • Identity & access management (zero trust, conditional access, PAM/PIM)
    • CI/CD pipelines and secure software development
    • AI / LLM
  • Partner closely with Cloud Ops and Product Architecture to ensure security is designed into enterprise platforms and product roadmaps.
  • Develop security reference architectures, and patterns aligned to Unit4’s security vision.
  • Design and implementation of layered enterprise security architectures, ensuring defence-in-depth and resilience across digital estates.
  • Act as a architectural authority in engagements interdepartmentally, providing well reasoned viewpoints on security principles, technologies, and patterns.
  • Ensure architectural decisions incorporate regulatory, customer, and audit requirements and are evidenced through pattern adoption and architecture reviews.
  • Partner closely with Product/Engineering, Enterprise Architecture and CloudOps to embed security controls, influence technology decisions, and ensure alignment to security strategy.
  • Engage with senior stakeholders to shape cyber direction and ensure architectural consistency across teams.

Cloud & Infrastructure Security

  • Secure architecture for multi‑cloud environments (Azure primary; awareness of AWS/GCP) across networking, compute, data, containers, and serverless.
  • Collaborate on the security design, engineering, and implementation of solutions within the Microsoft 365 (M365) and Entra ID ecosystems.
  • Consult on Microsoft security tooling including Microsoft Defender XDR, Defender for Cloud, Azure Policy, Endpoint management, Azure Network Security, and Conditional Access.
  • Evaluate new cloud services, ensuring risks are identified and mitigated before adoption.

Cloud Operations and Product

  • Collaborate on the security design for workloads deployed on cloud environments (Microsoft Azure preferred) (IaaS, PaaS, and Serverless), ensuring alignment with corporate security policy and regulatory requirements.
  • Develop secure reference architectures for Azure cloud services, covering:
  • Container platforms including AKS: cluster governance and baseline policies, workload identity, secrets management, runtime threat detection, tenancy/isolation and scale/cost guardrails.
  • Compute: VMs, scale sets, serverless workloads.
  • Storage & Data Services: Storage Accounts, Azure SQL, managed databases, key management, data loss prevention.
  • Mature security by design in Product, including compliance checks in pipeline, and architecture review and assurance for deviations from standards.
  • Contribute security nonfunctional requirements, reference patterns, and threat models to Product roadmaps; review high‑impact designs; ensure product changes align with enterprise guardrails. (Scope is collaborative and advisory, not ownership of Product delivery backlogs.)

Thought Leadership & Capability Building

  • Contribute to enterprise blueprints, playbooks, and whitepapers to mature the architectural practice.
  • Support the ongoing development of Unit4’s secure culture and help uplift security knowledge across technical teams.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor, articulating complex security concepts and risks to both technical and non‑technical audiences.

Essential Experience

  • 7–10+ years’ experience in IT or cybersecurity, with at least 3 years in a dedicated security architecture role.
  • Relevant industry certifications (e.g., CISSP, Microsoft Certified: Cyber security Architect Expert (SC-100), Azure Security Engineer (AZ-500)).
  • Proven experience designing large‑scale, secure enterprise solutions in complex organisations.
  • Deep technical expertise across cloud (Azure required), identity, network, endpoint, SaaS, and modern enterprise architectures.
  • Strong hands‑on knowledge of Microsoft security technologies (Defender XDR, Defender for Cloud, Conditional Access, Entra ID governance, PIM, etc.).
  • Demonstrated experience delivering Zero Trust concepts in production environments.
  • Strong understanding of DevSecOps principles and automation tooling.
  • Ability to clearly articulate security risks and solutions to both engineering teams and executive stakeholders.

Desirable Experience

  • Knowledge of major frameworks (NIST, ISO27001, SOC reporting, CIS, MITRE ATT&CK, CSA CCM).
  • Experience with IaC tools (Terraform, Bicep) and scripting languages (PowerShell, Python).
  • Experience designing scalable architectures for hybrid or multi‑cloud environments.
  • Prior experience in large enterprises, SaaS providers, or regulated sectors.

Soft Skills

  • Strong consulting-style capability: facilitation, stakeholder engagement, and outcome‑based delivery.
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguous environments and simplifying complexity.
  • Ability to operate independently, managing multiple projects and driving technical decisions.
  • Strategic thinker able to connect long‑term goals with short‑term action.
  • Collaborative and credible across cross‑functional teams.
  • Passionate about security, innovation, and helping the organisation grow securely.

Why This Role Matters

Security architecture underpins Unit4’s resilience, customer trust, and long‑term success. As Senior Security Architect, you will shape the future of how Unit4 protects and empowers its people, products, and global customer base. You will influence decisions across CISO, IT, and CloudOps and ensure that security is embedded at the heart of Unit4’s technology strategy.

Who we are

We are a people-first community that nurtures all the areas that surround your working experience. With us, you’ll be surrounded by a high-performance team that supports your authentic self and celebrates your uniqueness.
We believe that ‘How work should feel’ is an evolving statement. Work goes beyond tasks and everyday responsibilities it’s about feeling valued, empowered, promoted, impactful, seen, and appreciated.
We are reimagining how work makes people feel.

What we offer

• a culture built on trust and accountability - giving you the freedom and autonomy to be successful and make an impact
• balance - with our Flexible Leave Paid Time Off policy, remote working opportunities, Global Wellbeing Days, and other great benefits
• growth opportunities - we provide the tools and guidance required so that you can focus on what really matters to you and so, ultimately, you can achieve your best work
• talented colleagues, role models and mentors - work, learn and be inspired by some of the best talent in the software industry
• a commitment to sustainability - with initiatives such as our Environmental, Social, and Governance strategy and Act4Good programme
• a safe and inclusive working environment – supported by our Employee Resource Groups, which are open to all.

Our commitment to equity

Unit4 is committed to ensuring equal opportunity for everyone. We make our hiring decisions solely based on skills, qualifications, and our current business needs. We know that diversity brings fresh perspectives, ideas, and solutions to our company. This is the essence of our culture. We also welcome and encourage people who are pregnant and/or parents-to-be to apply. If you would like to know more about our commitment to diversity, visit our blogs:
• Our focus to DEI remains central to who we are
• Inclusive hiring at Unit4: Building equal opportunities for all

Background check

This role may require security clearance required for customer projects and access to sensitive (customer) data. That means that after you have accepted our offer, we could ask for background checks. Subject to applicable local laws, such security checks may require disclosure of personal information including criminal record declaration, right to work, personal identification and work history. No worries – we'll handle it according to local privacy laws and keep your information safe. Questions? Feel free to reach out!

Who we are

Why this job is exciting

The role:

This is a unique opportunity to work at the cutting-edge intersection of high-performance AI and confidential computing. You won't just be building another backend; you will be architecting the future of secure intelligence. In this role, you'll help solve the industry's most pressing challenge: how to run powerful AI models while maintaining absolute cryptographic certainty and data isolation. Joining our team means pushing the boundaries of what's possible in Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs) and ensuring that the next generation of enterprise AI is secure by design.

We are looking for an innovative Software Engineer to be the master weaver of our secure AI ecosystem. Rather than just following a manual, you will take ownership of the cross-layer integration and microservices architecture that makes our highly secure inference platform a reality. You will lead the charge in wiring complex multi-module backends and establishing the resilient endpoints that our customers depend on. Your mission is to implement sophisticated attestation-gated mechanisms, safeguarding critical model weights and execution boundaries within hardware-enforced environments. This is your chance to turn complex security protocols into seamless, high-performance reality.

Responsibilities:

  • Multi-Module & Application Integration: Program and stabilize core microservices, bridging backend data pipelines with advanced containerized inference runtimes to ensure seamless data flow.
  • Secure Endpoint Development: Design, expose, and optimize stable APIs for protected model ingestion, system lifecycle events, and inference requests.
  • Cryptographic Boundary Assembly: Integrate security sidecars and automated provisioning modules executing asymmetric decryption protocols (e.g., 4096-bit RSA) and cryptographic signature validation to facilitate attestation-gated asset release.
  • Network & Gateway Routing: Configure low-latency sidecar proxies and API gateways to maintain end-to-end encrypted pathways utilizing strict mutual authentication (mTLS).
  • Workload Orchestration: Maintain and update cloud-native application configurations (such as Helm charts) to orchestrate isolated container runtimes across distributed execution clusters.

Requirements:

  • Core Systems Programming: Professional fluency in Python, Rust, or C/C++ applied to performant backend services, API frameworks, or system microservices.
  • DevOps & Automation Agility: Familiarity constructing continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) automated pipelines, container orchestration scripts, and automated validation frameworks to facilitate continuous software updates.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Applied Cryptography Essentials: Knowledge of digital certificate management, public key infrastructure (PKI), asymmetric encryption tools (GPG), and transport security protocols (TLS 1.3/mTLS).
  • Hardware Security Foundations: Conceptual or practical familiarity with Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs), confidential computing isolation, or remote attestation concepts.
  • Cloud-Native AI Frameworks: Practical experience working with high-throughput inference engines and serving frameworks (such as vLLM or KServe) within containerized environments.

What you can expect from us

Capacity team members enjoy the opportunity and benefits of working at an artificial intelligence startup, but with leaders who’ve worked at places like Apple, Ebay, Visa, Answers.com, Oracle, Boeing, and many more world-class companies. Still unsure?

But wait, there’s more!
