jobs.excerpt: Highlights:• Location: Poland, Remote • Language: Fluent in Russian; English (B2) About Fundraise UpWe’re Fundraise Up - a global fundraising platform built to make donating to nonprofits fast, seamless, and accessible to all.
jobs.description:
Highlights:

  • Location: Poland, Remote
  • Language: Fluent in Russian; English (B2)

About Fundraise Up

We’re Fundraise Up - a global fundraising platform built to make donating to nonprofits fast, seamless, and accessible to all. Every month, our technology powers tens of millions of dollars in donations across the globe. We focus on innovation that directly impacts results: faster load times, higher conversion rates, global payment support, and accessibility-first design.

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading nonprofits, including UNICEF, the Alzheimer’s Association, and a wide range of global NGOs. With a 4.9/5 rating across top software review platforms, we’re recognized not just for our impact - but for the quality of the product we deliver.

A Truly Global Product

We operate in the enterprise segment, serving nonprofit organizations across North America, the United Kingdom, Australia, and Europe.

We’re building a large and complex product ecosystem that serves nonprofits, donors, and partners around the world. The platform includes a modern checkout experience and customizable widgets (each a standalone SPA), donor, organization, and partner portals, admin tools, and several internal apps.

Our backend is powered by Node.js (Koa, NestJS) and MongoDB. The frontend stack includes Webpack, Vue.js, and React, with nearly all code written in TypeScript. For high-throughput messaging and background processing, we use Kafka (for millions of events) and Bull (Redis). Analytics data is stored in ClickHouse, and we use Elasticsearch for search.

The Team

We are a distributed team of 160+ product professionals, including 80+ engineers. Our team members are mainly based across Spain, Poland, Portugal, Georgia, Armenia, Serbia, Turkey, and Cyprus. Despite our scale, we operate like a focused team — where every task matters and every voice is heard. We value thoughtful collaboration, strong engineering practices, and a product mindset.

About the Mobile Team

You'll join the mobile team inside our Engineering department. The team builds the products that let nonprofits accept donations in the physical world. Tap to Donate lets a staff member or volunteer accept contactless payments directly on a smartphone. Giving Station is a self-service donation point: a donor selects an amount on a tablet and pays through a connected external payment terminal.

Our mobile stack:

  • bare React Native (0.79, Old Architecture)
  • React 19, TypeScript
  • React Navigation 7, TanStack Query 5, React Context
  • react-hook-form, Zod
  • an internal UI Kit built with twrnc
  • Stripe Terminal, Tap to Pay, external payment terminals
  • Sentry, PostHog
  • Node.js, NestJS, React, MongoDB, ClickHouse, and Redis across the backend and web stack

About the Role

You will design, build, and maintain the mobile applications that power Fundraise Up's product on iOS and Android. Mobile is the primary focus, with contributions extending to the backend and web frontend the product depends on to deliver features end-to-end. You'll work across the full development lifecycle — from requirements analysis through implementation, testing, store release, and production support — and ensure the applications are reliable, performant, and secure across the devices and OS versions in use.

What You'll Do

  • Implement features, fix bugs, and resolve production incidents across iOS and Android, extending to the backend and web frontend the product depends on — delivering tested, production-ready output that meets the team's quality bar.
  • Own mobile initiatives end-to-end — gather requirements, design the approach, decompose into tasks, implement, and deliver to production across iOS and Android, including the backend and web frontend changes they require.
  • Act as the team's primary technical escalation point for complex mobile problems — diagnose root causes across the app, native layers, networking, and platform behavior, and prevent recurrence.
  • Review code and designs for correctness — component and navigation structure, rendering, native integration, and alignment with mobile patterns — catching issues before release.
  • Contribute to and evolve mobile engineering standards within the team — component architecture, native integration, testing, and release policy.
  • Monitor the operational health of shipped work — track releases and staged rollouts, watch release health, and respond to post-release issues on both platforms.

Requirements

  • 8+ years of professional software development experience, including 3+ years with React Native.
  • Proficiency in React Native and TypeScript — the primary craft.
  • Strong JavaScript fundamentals — asynchronous programming, event loop behavior, error handling.
  • Working knowledge of relational and document databases — data modeling, querying, indexing.
  • Understanding of RESTful API design and HTTP fundamentals — able to work across Node.js backend services, API contracts, database queries, and web frontend code.
  • Familiarity with the native iOS and Android platforms and their tooling (Xcode, Android Studio, Gradle).
  • Understanding of mobile OS fundamentals — app lifecycle, background execution, permissions, and memory constraints.
  • Experience with automated testing practices (unit, integration, E2E).
  • Understanding of mobile security — secure storage and handling of sensitive and payment data.
  • Confident day-to-day use of AI-assisted development tools — for research, troubleshooting, and implementation.
  • Ability to independently diagnose common React Native production issues — rendering, navigation, networking, and app lifecycle.
  • Track record of owning mobile initiatives end-to-end — from requirements through store release, including the backend and web frontend changes they require.
  • Experience designing mobile application architecture — trade-offs in performance, reliability, and observability across iOS and Android.
  • Experience designing or integrating native modules and SDKs where React Native abstractions are insufficient — including focused Swift/Kotlin changes and debugging across the JavaScript and native layers.
  • Experience owning the release process — app signing, store submission, and staged rollouts.
  • Experience establishing mobile engineering practice from little — standards, CI/CD, and release — across inherited and greenfield codebases.
  • Experience designing resilient asynchronous and event-driven backend interactions (messaging, queues).
  • Experience with mobile production operations — monitoring, crash reporting, incident response, and rollback policy.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor and develop less experienced engineers.
  • English proficiency sufficient for daily written and verbal communication.

Nice to Have

  • Broader backend and database experience.
  • Experience with event-driven architectures and asynchronous messaging patterns.
  • Experience operating high-traffic, low-latency systems.
  • Experience with offline-first architectures and data synchronization over unreliable networks.
  • Familiarity with React Native's New Architecture (JSI, Fabric, TurboModules, Codegen) and the native library compatibility constraints of migrating to it.
  • Native development depth in Swift and/or Kotlin beyond React Native.
  • Experience with in-person or mobile payments and fintech products.
  • Experience with Stripe Terminal, Tap to Pay, or NFC.
  • Experience in a distributed, remote-first engineering organization.

Why work with us

  • A strong, collaborative product team that owns what it builds
  • Clear product vision and access to real customer feedback from global nonprofit leaders
  • Flat structure: no politics, just great work with great people
  • Transparent company culture-we share how we’re growing, where revenue comes from, and what’s next
  • Long-term focus: we offer equity options and value sustained, meaningful contribution

Compensation

  • The compensation range for this role is: €5,900 - €6,800 gross per month.
  • Final compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, skills, qualifications, and alignment with the role's requirements.

Benefits

  • 31 days off
  • 100% paid telemedicine plan
  • Home Office Setup Assistance: the company offers assistance with purchasing furniture (office chair, office desk, monitor) and other items to create a comfortable workspace
  • English learning courses
  • Relevant professional education
  • Gym or swimming pool
  • Co-working
  • Remote working

**Please note: All official correspondence from Fundraise Up will exclusively originate from the @fundraiseup.com domain. Exercise caution and ensure the authenticity of emails claiming to be from our company.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law in the countries where we operate.

Partnership Executive/Investment Sales & Business Advisor
​

This is not a typical sales job. But it starts with sales.

We're looking for someone rare — a person who is wired to prospect, pitch, and close, AND sophisticated enough to act as a trusted business advisor to high-performing entrepreneurs.

If that describes you, keep reading.

What You're Selling

Fusion Growth Partners is an Inc. 5000 company (ranked 813th nationally) that invests capital, staff, and infrastructure directly into the businesses of residential real estate agents — helping them scale from solo producer to true enterprise. We fund their marketing, hire and pay their staff, and build the operational machine. Our partners don't pay us a coaching fee — we earn a return from the revenue growth we help them generate.

You are selling one of the most compelling business propositions in the market: growth funding with no out-of-pocket cost to the client, backed by a proven model and over 300 team members delivering the work.

The Role — Two Phases

Phase 1: Sales & Business Development (Inside Sales) You will prospect, present, and close new partner relationships. This means outbound outreach, structured sales conversations on Zoom, and guiding high-earning real estate professionals through a detailed evaluation of our investment model. Our close rate at the final deal stage exceeds 50%.

If you don't genuinely love the hunt — the calls, the follow-up, the pipeline — this is not for you. If you do, there are few better platforms to excel.

Phase 2: Advisory & Portfolio Management As your book of business grows, your role evolves. You become the board-level advisor to your partners — running strategy meetings, driving accountability, and ensuring every partner in your portfolio is growing. This is where sophistication matters. You must be able to influence strong-willed, high-income entrepreneurs and guide them to take actions that will benefit their business even when those actions require patience.

The Entrepreneurial Path — Build Something of Your Own

This is where it gets different.

Fusion is in a period of rapid national expansion. The opportunity ahead of you is not just a sales job — it is the foundation of your own business division within Fusion. As you prove yourself, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Become a Contract Negotiator (Hero) — running final deal meetings for the broader team, exclusively focused on closing
  • Build a Consulting Portfolio — your own book of partner clients generating recurring revenue-share income
  • Lead Your Own Division as Vice President — recruiting, training, and mentoring your own team of Partnership Executives, with an override on every client in your division

Think of it less like climbing a corporate ladder and more like building a franchise within a proven system. The infrastructure, the brand, the model, and the clients are already here. The question is how big you want to build it.

Compensation & Earnings Potential

This is a commission-based, revenue-sharing role with a typical first-year earning potential of $70,000. As you build your partner portfolio and expand your book of business, your income potential scales rapidly realistic earnings can reach $250,000+ annually within your first three years. Commission is uncapped and directly tied to the growth of your portfolio and division, putting your earning power completely in your hands.

  • You can hold a sophisticated conversation with a six-figure business owner and earn their trust
  • You think like an entrepreneur and want to build something, not just collect a paycheck

jobs.title: Head of Partner Growth (100% Remote)
jobs.excerpt: The Role:This role is all about growth.  In 2025, we made a deliberate strategic choice to exit the freight forwarding business to eliminate conflicts of interest, choosing instead to build a trust-first partner model.
jobs.description:
The Role:

This role is all about growth. In 2025, we made a deliberate strategic choice to exit the freight forwarding business to eliminate conflicts of interest, choosing instead to build a trust-first partner model. It worked, and we now have a solid foundation of 30+ partners.

Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer (COO), your mandate is to take this foundation and aggressively scale it. We are looking for a commercial leader who can identify, pitch, and onboard new partners while turning our existing network into a massive revenue engine. You will sit at the intersection of Sales, Operations, and Technology, acting as the primary catalyst for our partner channel expansion. (Note: This is a highly autonomous, individual contributor role).

Responsibilities:

  • Drive Partner Acquisition: Hunt, pitch, and onboard new freight forwarders, carriers, and logistics providers to expand the BorderBuddy partner network.

  • Accelerate Channel Revenue: Turn partnerships into active, predictable lead-generation engines. Train and enable partners to confidently sell integrated BorderBuddy customs solutions, leveraging Zipments’ tech tools.

  • Build for Scale: Take a network that is currently relationship-driven and build and implement playbooks, standard agreements, and scalable pricing frameworks needed to grow it exponentially.

  • Drive Tech Adoption: Work with the Zipments team to help partners embed proprietary tech tools (tracking widgets, duty calculators, bond sales) to drive customs brokerage leads and increase stickiness.

  • Manage Key Relationships: Establish a strategic cadence (MBRs/QBRs) with top-tier partners to ensure ongoing health, uncover up-sell opportunities, and route all customs brokerage leads seamlessly into BorderBuddy.

What Success Looks Like:

  1. Net-New Growth: Measurable, significant increase in new partners onboarded to the BorderBuddy ecosystem.

  2. Revenue Generation: A massive uptick in inbound lead volume and closed revenue generated directly from the partner channel.

  3. Tech Stickiness: Zipments tool adoption has measurably increased across the partner network.

Who You Are (Experience and Skills):

  • The Hunter Mentality: 3–5 years of experience in Business Development, Channel Sales, or Partner Growth. (Experience in freight forwarding or customs brokerage is a massive advantage).

  • Growth-Obsessed: You don't just manage relationships; you know how to build a pipeline, close deals, and drive commercial revenue.

  • Comfortable in Ambiguity: You lean into evolving spaces and enjoy the challenge of building the map while driving the car.

  • Exceptional Communicator: You can confidently pitch to external teams, navigate complex partner dynamics, and collaborate internally.

  • Tech-Savvy: You are energized by modern technology and eager to leverage AI tools and CRM data to accelerate your pipeline.

  • Team Player: You take extreme ownership of outcomes and genuinely care about the partner and end-client experience.

At BorderBuddy, we offer our staff a relaxed work atmosphere, a supportive work environment, as well as a competitive compensation package (health & dental benefits, RRSP/401k contribution, tuition reimbursement programs, professional training, and paid time off).

BorderBuddy is an excellent place to develop your career. As part of a growing organization investing heavily in both brokerage excellence and the future of trade technology, the infrastructure you build here will directly impact our trajectory.

Working Conditions:

This is a full-time, 100% remote role based in Canada. We offer a relaxed work atmosphere, a highly supportive environment, and a competitive compensation package including health & dental benefits, RRSP contributions, tuition reimbursement, and paid time off.

While we sincerely appreciate all applications, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

Who We are:

BorderBuddy is a digital-first customs brokerage built for SMBs, mid-market importers, and ecommerce merchants. We prioritize customer service, ease of use, transparency, and tech-enabled processes. Unlike traditional customs brokers, BorderBuddy was established after the advent of the Internet—the same year Apple introduced the iPhone. Over the last 18 years, we have adeptly managed the importation of a wide array of goods, gaining the trust of over 80,000 clients and earning a 4.8-star rating with over 2,400 Google reviews.

Complementing our brokerage is Zipments.io, our proprietary technology platform. Zipments powers automation, data intake, and tracking, offering a growing suite of tools such as PARS and PAPS tracking, real-time duty and tax calculation, HS classification, CARM bond purchasing, and CUSMA/USMCA certificate generation. These tools are used internally to improve operations, and licensed externally to our partners and their clients to enhance visibility and the overall user experience.

While BorderBuddy champions SMBs, we are backed by the A&A Group of Companies, which supports large enterprise importers. Along with Zipments, this structure gives us a unique position in the market. We maintain strong partner relationships without conflict of interest concerns, given our deliberate decision not to compete in the freight forwarding business. And while traditional brokers rely on physical offices at ports of entry, we leverage our cutting-edge technology to provide seamless, compliant customs services through a 100% remote working team across Canada and the U.S. We are focused on modernizing the standard approach to customs clearance—and we’re growing fast.

Our Culture:

We are a values-based organization and a dedicated group of professionals committed to innovation, teamwork, learning and development. We take a great deal of pride in developing long-term relationships and in supporting our partners, our community and our environment.

Our Promise:

  • We thrive on helping people.

  • At BorderBuddy, we are committed to helping our employees reach their full potential by developing their skills and careers.

  • We strive to be the best employer in our community and in our industry.

Our People Principles:

Our Principles guide us in delivering on our People Promise. They commit us to:

  • Create a team of engaged and committed A Players;

  • Make a difference to help employees learn and grow;

  • Truly care about your quality of life.

The Sales Executive, HubSpot Partner Sales sits at the intersection of new business and account expansion. Reporting to the VP of Sales and Marketing, you will be the first point of contact for opportunities referred by HubSpot's Small Business and Mid-Market sales teams, and you will own revenue growth within our existing book of business. This is not a pure hunting role and it is not pure account management. It is a consultative selling position for someone who can run a strong discovery call, generate their own pipeline through smart outbound work, spot an opportunity inside an existing relationship, and partner closely with our service delivery team to turn great work into lasting engagements.

This role is ideal for a salesperson who has outgrown a small business seat and is ready to carry larger revenue responsibility, and who wants to develop their skills alongside experienced sellers before taking on our largest and most complex opportunities.

What You'll Do

HubSpot Co-Sell and New Business Discovery

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for inbound referrals from HubSpot Small Business and Mid-Market sales reps, responding with urgency and professionalism
  • Lead initial discovery calls with prospects to understand business goals, current systems, pain points, and readiness for a partner engagement
  • Qualify opportunities based on fit, budget, authority, need, and timeline, and route qualified deals to the appropriate next step in our sales process
  • Build and maintain strong working relationships with HubSpot reps, client success managers, and our partner development manager to keep 1406 top of mind for referrals
  • Document discovery findings clearly so scoping and solutions teams can build accurate proposals

Outbound Prospecting

  • Develop pipeline through targeted outbound outreach, starting with the warmest paths: past clients, closed lost opportunities, and dormant relationships already in our CRM
  • Build and execute thoughtful, personalized outreach sequences across email, phone, and LinkedIn that reflect 1406's consultative brand rather than high-volume spray tactics
  • Re-engage closed lost opportunities with relevant timing triggers such as new funding, leadership changes, HubSpot product launches, or shifts in their tech stack
  • Leverage modern prospecting and sales intelligence tools (we will equip you with what you need) to identify and reach good-fit accounts within our ideal client profile
  • Partner with marketing to align outbound messaging with active campaigns and content

Upsell and Cross-Sell Within Our Book of Business

  • Proactively review our existing client base to identify expansion opportunities across additional Hubs, integrations, training, and strategic services
  • Partner with account and delivery teams to time expansion conversations around client milestones, renewals, and roadmap discussions
  • Run consultative conversations with existing clients that connect their evolving business goals to new areas where 1406 can help
  • Maintain a healthy expansion pipeline with accurate forecasting in HubSpot

Sales Operations and Collaboration

  • Maintain pristine CRM records, pipeline stages, and forecasts in HubSpot
  • Collaborate with scoping and solutions architecture teammates during pre-sales to ensure proposed engagements are accurate, profitable, and aligned with client goals
  • Ensure a seamless handoff from sales to service by documenting client requirements, success metrics, and commitments for the delivery team
  • Contribute to sales playbooks, outreach sequences, and process improvements as we scale
  • Represent 1406 at HubSpot events and within the partner ecosystem as opportunities arise

What You'll Bring

Required: HubSpot Partner Ecosystem Experience

  • Demonstrated experience selling HubSpot at a Solutions Partner agency, or as a HubSpot AE who worked closely with the partner channel on services-led deals
  • Recent, hands-on familiarity with how the HubSpot Partner Program actually works: deal registration, co-sell and referral workflows, working relationships with HubSpot reps and partner development managers, and how partner-sourced pipeline gets tracked and credited
  • A working understanding of what a HubSpot implementation and services engagement actually involves, so you can speak credibly to scope, timeline, and value rather than selling the platform in the abstract

Also Required

  • 2 to 4 years of B2B sales experience, ideally selling professional services, consulting engagements, marketing or RevOps retainers, or SaaS implementation services
  • Experience running discovery or qualification calls independently, with a consultative and educational approach rather than a scripted pitch
  • Demonstrated outbound prospecting experience, including writing your own sequences and personalizing outreach at the account level; familiarity with sales intelligence and prospecting platforms is a plus
  • Comfort collaborating with technical and delivery teammates, and humility about looping in experts when a conversation goes deeper than your knowledge
  • Strong written communication for proposals, follow-ups, and internal documentation
  • Organized pipeline management habits and a belief that clean CRM data is part of the job, not an afterthought
  • A growth mindset: you want coaching, you want feedback, and you want a clear path toward larger deals and greater ownership

Nice to Have

  • Active HubSpot certifications (Inbound Sales, Sales Software, or similar)
  • Familiarity with co-selling motions alongside a software vendor's sales team
  • Experience with renewal or account management conversations for services businesses
  • Customer Success experience at a HubSpot partner or SaaS company, paired with direct selling experience elsewhere

Why 1406

  • Work inside the top 1% of the HubSpot partner ecosystem, with direct exposure to HubSpot's Small Business and Mid-Market sales organizations and some of the most interesting implementation work in the ecosystem
  • A defined growth path: this role is designed as a launching point toward senior sales positions as you demonstrate results
  • A collaborative, globally distributed team culture built on our five core company values
  • Competitive base salary plus commission, with benefits including health, dental, vision, 401(k), PTO.

Position Summary
As a Principal AI/ML Research Engineer, this technical leader will drive applied AI research, novel model development, and algorithmic innovation across generative AI (GenAI), deep learning, and traditional machine learning. This technologist will lead the discovery, design, and prototyping of state-of-the-art architectures to solve complex, high-scale commerce and fintech challenges. For example, this work may include pioneering Transformer-based Payment Foundation Models (PFMs)—adapting self-attention mechanisms to large-scale tabular transaction data, user behavioral sequences, and multi-modal financial streams to produce universal embeddings that power a wide array of downstream commerce applications.

This role bridges state-of-the-art academic/industry research with real-world production impact. You will closely partner with leaders in Data Engineering, Product, Security, Risk & Compliance, and Line of Business (LOB) technical teams to identify high-value opportunities, benchmark novel architectures (e.g., Tabular Transformers, LLMs, RAG, Reinforcement Learning), and transition experimental models into viable production pipelines.

This Principal AI/ML Research Engineer will hold technical ownership of WEX’s AI research strategy, model optimization, algorithmic rigor, and AI experimentation standards. The vision behind WEX’s AI research is to transform multi-modal commerce and payment data into intelligent, predictive models that drive competitive advantage.

This role reports to the VP of Data Lake and AI Engineering located in the San Jose, CA Bay Area, but can be located in Seattle, WA; Portland, ME; Boston, MA; or Chicago, IL. The ideal candidate is a hands-on technical leader with deep domain knowledge in applied AI/ML research, statistical modeling, and experimental design, combined with strong strategic vision and communication skills.

Responsibilities

  • Self-Supervised Pre-Training & Fine-Tuning: Design self-supervised pre-training strategies (e.g., masked transaction prediction) on raw payment histories to generate multi-purpose user/entity embeddings, enabling efficient fine-tuning for fraud detection, credit risk, dispute prediction, and authorization optimization.

  • Payment Foundation Models & Transformers: Drive applied research in adapting Transformer architectures (encoder/decoder, self-attention mechanisms, and Tabular Transformers) to build enterprise-grade Payment Foundation Models (PFMs) tailored to transaction streams.

  • Research & Algorithmic Innovation: Lead applied research in AI/ML to solve high-impact business problems in fraud detection, risk scoring, predictive commerce, customer engagement, and automated decision-making.

  • Generative AI & Advanced Modeling: Spearhead research and prototyping in modern AI frameworks—including LLM fine-tuning, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agentic workflows, multi-modal systems, and Reinforcement Learning.

  • AI agent Feedback and Self-learning/improvement: lead development of effective framework and methodologies in auto AI agent feedback collection and agent self-learning and self-improvement.

  • Model Optimization: lead AI model optimization for performance, latency, and cost for Wex use cases, including developing model routers.

  • AI Agent Eval: lead the development of effective AI agent evaluation methodologies.

  • Lead or participate in multidisciplinary design reviews and drive technical action items to closure.
  • Develop engineering documentation including design bases, interface definitions, design evaluations, and technical reports.
  • Support hazard analyses, licensing activities, commissioning, and facility integration.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering field
  • Minimum of 5 years of relevant engineering experience
  • Experience developing, specifying, integrating, or implementing industrial process equipment
  • Experience working with equipment vendors, technical specifications, procurement packages, or design reviews
  • Experience with 3D CAD tools, 2D fabrication drawings, equipment specifications, and controlled design documentation
  • Familiarity with P&IDs, mechanical equipment layouts, process equipment interfaces, material handling concepts, and vendor design packages
  • Strong mechanical engineering judgment, including practical understanding of maintainability, reliability, fabrication, inspection, and failure modes
  • Experience coordinating work across multiple engineering disciplines
  • Ability to produce clear, traceable technical documentation in support of design development, procurement, safety review, or licensing activities

Bonus Qualifications:

  • Experience in nuclear, chemical processing, mining, manufacturing, or other highly regulated industrial facilities
  • Experience in commercial nuclear, DOE, advanced reactor, fuel cycle, waste treatment, or high-reliability industrial projects
  • Experience with radioactive waste processing, packaging, containerization, storage, or disposal systems in a hot-cell environment
  • Experience developing equipment for size reduction, compaction, filtration, solidification, packaging, container handling, drum handling, cask/canister interfaces, or remote/assisted maintenance
  • Familiarity with waste characterization, waste acceptance criteria, contamination control, ALARA principles, or radiological work planning
  • Familiarity with radioactive waste classification, regulation, or nuclear material packaging requirements
  • Experience with design for manufacturability, design for automation, or design for remote handling and maintainability
  • Experience with Solidworks
  • Experience supporting hazard analysis, failure modes analysis, commissioning, readiness reviews, or startup of industrial process systems

Competencies

We are looking for a Mechanical Engineer who is:

  • Practical, production-focused, and able to distinguish between a concept that works on paper and a system that can be operated and maintained
  • Experienced in mechanical design of industrial process equipment, material handling systems, packaging systems, and waste processing equipment
  • Comfortable translating process objectives into equipment requirements, vendor specifications, operating sequences, and acceptance criteria
  • Skilled at reviewing P&IDs, equipment layouts, mechanical interfaces, and vendor drawings
  • Able to identify maintainability, reliability, operability, and implementation risks early in design
  • Effective working across engineering disciplines and with external suppliers
  • Comfortable driving technical issues to resolution in a fast-paced development environment
  • Clear and direct in written and verbal communication, including design review comments and technical documentation
  • Energized by developing safe, compliant, and practical systems for radioactive waste processing and handling
  • Willing to propose creative, technically grounded solutions rather than relying only on precedent

Who you are:

A startup person: You aren't driven by titles or hierarchy, and prefer efficiency to excess process. You don't need or expect to have a lot of guidance but you enjoy working in a fast-paced team. If you prefer the culture and feel of a large organization, that is great, but you likely won’t enjoy working with us! There is plenty of important work and plenty of good opportunities with organizations like that.

Motivated: You are self-motivated. You bring an enthusiasm to the team, and imbue a sense of passion that goes beyond clocking in and clocking out. This isn’t about a fake or arbitrary “pieces of flair” mentality or lack of work-life balance! It is about being a part of the vision and feeling a part of reaching team goals.

A team-player: Oklo genuinely is a team. We aren’t about taking credit for ourselves, and we aren’t about pushing blame to others. We do incredible things because we work as a team.

An excellent communicator: We need a person who is not only technically competent but also a clear and upbeat communicator.

Creative: Being creative means that when things fall outside clear scopes or processes or problems arise without clear solutions, you are able to identify it as well as invent ways to solve a problem or fill a need without micromanagement. The successful person in this job will not only be creative, but also enjoy being creative and solving open-ended problems which may change day-by-day.

Detail-oriented: This focus is a big part of excellence, consistency, and quality. Excellent grammar and spelling matter for both good communication as well as the image of the company that we put forward.

About Oklo travel requirements:

Oklo requires remote employees to travel to headquarters (Santa Clara, CA) twice a quarter annually, based on business or team needs, including attendance at team meetings, off-sites, and other company events or gatherings. For the first two weeks of onboarding, employees are required to be in person at headquarters in Santa Clara, CA.

About Oklo compensation:

Salary: $120,000-$170,000

Oklo offers flexible time off, equity, bonuses, competitive pay, 401(k), health insurance (with employer contribution), HSA, FSA, flexible work hours, wellness credits, and other benefits.

This position may involve access to information subject to U.S. export control laws. Only applicants who meet the definition of a U.S. person under applicable laws may be eligible.

About Oklo Inc.: Oklo Inc. is developing fast fission power plants to deliver clean, reliable, and affordable energy at scale; establishing a domestic supply chain for critical radioisotopes; and advancing nuclear fuel recycling to convert nuclear waste into clean energy. Oklo was the first to receive a site use permit from the U.S. Department of Energy for a commercial advanced fission plant, was awarded fuel material from Idaho National Laboratory, and submitted the first custom combined license application for an advanced reactor to the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission. Oklo is also developing advanced fuel recycling technologies in collaboration with the U.S. Department of Energy and U.S. National Laboratories.

#CHOP: Oklo’s Values
Collaboration: We go further, together. We bring diverse perspectives, listen actively, and build trust through transparency and respect. We work across disciplines, sharing ownership to turn complex challenges into shared successes.
Humility: We are team players who act for the good of the company and for the world. We are focused on our mission, not personal recognition.
Ownership: We take pride in what we do and how we do it. We are proactive in finding solutions and see tasks through to completion. We are committed to delivering on our promises to provide clean, reliable, and affordable energy.
Pathfinding: We chart new ground where no path exists by approaching challenges with curiosity, courage, and creativity while navigating ambiguity.

Candidates should be aware that employment may be contingent upon successful completion of a drug screening, and employees may be subject to drug testing at any time in accordance with company policy and applicable laws.

Recruitment Fraud Disclaimer

Oklo is aware of recent recruitment fraud attempts targeting job seekers. Please be cautious of anyone claiming to represent Oklo who does not contact you from an official Oklo email address.

All legitimate communications from our recruiting team— including application updates, interview requests, and job offers — will come exclusively from an @oklo.com email. Oklo will never ask for sensitive personal information, payments, or account credentials during the hiring process.

If you receive suspicious outreach or have concerns about the authenticity of any communication claiming to be from Oklo, please contact us through the official channels listed on our website.

jobs.description:
Spinwheel is the agentic API platform for real-time consumer credit data and payments. With just a phone number and date of birth, financial innovators get instant access to complete consumer credit data, attributes, and payments, all through a single, beautifully simple API.

We serve banks, lenders, fintechs, credit unions, and other financial services companies that need to verify identity, understand consumer debt, and execute payments at scale. Our platform combines Connect (identity and account authentication), Profile (real-time debt intelligence from all three bureaus), and Pay (payments and balance transfers) into a unified infrastructure layer.

We're a growth-stage company. The team is lean, the clients are sophisticated, and the market opportunity is large. The sales motion is enterprise B2B: complex, consultative, and technical.

The Role

We're hiring an Enterprise Account Executive to own new business. This is a full-cycle role. You'll run discovery, structure deals, navigate legal and technical procurement, and close new clients across our primary verticals: banks, lenders, and fintechs.

You'll work closely with SDRs, Product Marketing, and our technical team. You'll also carry commercial ownership for your largest accounts post-close, acting as the de facto account manager until a deal reaches the scale to warrant a dedicated handoff.

This is not a commodity sale. Spinwheel's buyers are product managers, payments leads, and engineering stakeholders, and are sophisticated about what they're buying. The AE who succeeds here can articulate infrastructure tradeoffs, navigate multi-stakeholder deals, and build executive relationships with financial institutions.

What You'll Own

New Business

  • Manage the full sales cycle for new clients, from inbound qualification and outbound prospecting through discovery, demo, negotiation, and close.
  • Run structured discovery to understand a prospect's consumer credit lifecycle, technical architecture, and current vendors before proposing a solution.
  • Navigate multi-stakeholder deals involving product, engineering, legal, compliance, and executive buyers.
  • Collaborate with SDRs on account strategy for target accounts; provide clear feedback to improve inbound qualification.
  • Build and maintain a pipeline with sufficient coverage to meet targets; forecast accurately and consistently in HubSpot.
Market Intelligence and Collaboration
  • Develop a working knowledge of the competitive landscape, including competition, bureau-direct options, and adjacent players, and apply it in active deals.
  • Share deal learnings, win/loss patterns, and buyer language with Product Marketing to sharpen positioning and enablement materials.
  • Flag product gaps and market signals to product and leadership as a trusted voice of the buyer.

What We're Looking For

Experience

  • 5+ years of full-cycle B2B sales experience, with at least 2 years direct Fintech, API, or selling into lending institutions (banks, lenders, fintechs, credit unions).
  • Experience and track record of success closing complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals rather than transactional volume sales.
  • Experience selling infrastructure, data, or API-based products is strongly preferred. You don't need to write code, but you need to understand how APIs are evaluated and bought.
  • Familiarity with the consumer credit ecosystem, including bureaus, identity verification, payments rails, or lending workflows, is a meaningful advantage.
  • Proven success meeting or exceeding quota

Skills and Attributes

  • Discovery-first mindset: you ask before you pitch, and you can translate a prospect's business problem into a product recommendation.
  • Technical fluency: comfortable in conversations that involve API integration, data normalization, compliance considerations, and technical architecture, even when you're not the technical expert in the room.
  • Intellectual honesty: you represent the product accurately, manage expectations clearly, and know when a deal isn't a fit.
  • Data-driven: you own your pipeline numbers, understand what they mean, and use them to prioritize your time.
  • Grit: the fintech sales cycle can be long, the buying committee is complex, and deals stall. You stay persistent and creative without becoming pushy.
  • Collaboration: you work well with SDRs, CSMs, and technical resources. You prepare properly before bringing in support, and you give credit freely.

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary and variable compensation (50% base, 50% commission).
  • Equity in a high-growth infrastructure company at an early and critical stage.
  • A lean, high-trust environment where your deals actually move the needle.
  • Direct access to leadership, product, and engineering with no bureaucracy between you and the answers you need.
  • Opportunity to help shape the sales process, not just execute it.

Role Overview: We’re looking for an experienced Bookkeeper to take ownership of day-to-day accounts and bookkeeping operations. You’ll manage invoicing, AP/AR, payroll preparation, and reporting across a multi-stream business where 80% of revenue is federal government funded. You’ll work closely with the internal operations lead and the external accounting team that handles tax lodgement.

  • Manage accounts receivable and accounts payable end-to-end, including reconciliations and follow-ups.
  • Prepare and process payroll in Xero, ready for sign-off and final payment by the operations lead bi weekly.
  • Support BAS and PAYG preparation alongside the operations lead.
  • Maintain a clean chart of accounts (provided) and ensure source documentation is accurate and ready for the external tax team.
  • Generate regular P&L, balance sheet and management reports.
  • Flag cost trends and suggest improvements to cash flow, margins and spend where relevant.
  • Coordinate with the internal CRM/timesheet system, which feeds both payroll and invoicing.
  • General office accounts management and support for day to day business operations.

  • 3+ years bookkeeping experience supporting Australian businesses.
  • Strong working knowledge of Xero — payroll, invoicing, reconciliations, reporting.
  • Solid understanding of the Australian tax environment (ATO, BAS, PAYG, GST).
  • Confident with chart of accounts, P&L and balance sheet interpretation.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.
  • Strong logical reasoning and the ability to pick up industry-specific invoicing rules.
  • Comfortable working behind a VPN.

Nice-to-Have:

  • Prior experience in aged care, NDIS, community services or any federally funded health/care sector.
  • Exposure to CRM-based timesheet systems feeding payroll and invoicing.
  • Familiarity with multi-entity or multi-stream invoicing environments.

Work Arrangement & Expectations:

This is a remote role that will be set up as an independent contractor engagement.

To ensure alignment and transparency, successful candidates will be expected to:

  • Disclose any existing ongoing roles or client work
  • Reflect this engagement on their LinkedIn profile (clearly marked as “Independent Contractor”)

Financial Accounting and Bookkeeping

Vietnam Financial Data Management

  • Review monthly financial statements prepared by the local Vietnamese accounting partner.
  • Perform data-quality checks and map financial information to the established internal Chart of Accounts.
  • Complete VND-to-USD foreign currency translations using approved rates.
  • Upload accurate, mapped financial data into the relevant QuickBooks Online accounts.

Compliance and Audit Support

  • Gather financial data and prepare supporting documentation for Singapore statutory filings, including corporate tax filings, ACRA annual returns, and FATCA-related requirements.

  • Experience with foreign currency translation and group-level reporting.

The successful contractor will maintain accurate and timely books, complete reconciliations and data uploads with minimal correction, keep financial documentation organized and audit-ready, communicate issues early, and reliably meet month-end and audit deadlines while working independently.

jobs.description:
This is a fully remote opportunity for the role of Sales / Appointment Setter (Female).
Applications that include an introduction video will be prioritized.
Due to the fully remote nature of this position, candidates should be comfortable communicating through video calls.

ROLE TITLE

Sales / Appointment Setter (Female)

ROLE SUMMARY

You serve as the first point of contact between potential customers and the sales team. Your responsibility is not simply answering inquiries—it is ensuring every inbound lead is qualified correctly, responded to promptly, and moved efficiently through the sales pipeline.

Every interaction should move a prospect one step closer to becoming a customer.

On a daily basis, you will encounter:

  • high volumes of inbound inquiries
  • leads with varying levels of buying intent
  • incomplete customer information
  • scheduling conflicts
  • follow-up opportunities that require persistence
  • multiple communication channels requiring quick response

Your role is to prioritize qualified opportunities, maintain accurate lead records, and ensure no sales opportunity is lost due to poor follow-up or delayed communication.

This position requires initiative. Waiting for reminders before responding to leads or following up on prospects creates missed revenue opportunities.

Filtering Signal: This role is not suitable for individuals who require constant supervision, avoid voice conversations, or struggle with sales follow-up and customer engagement.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES (REAL-WORLD EXECUTION)

1. Inbound Lead Management (Speed & Response)

  • Respond promptly to inbound inquiries received through landing pages, social media, email, and other marketing channels
  • Gather missing information to properly qualify each prospect
  • Ensure every lead receives timely communication
  • Identify high-intent opportunities and prioritize accordingly

2. Lead Qualification (Sales Pipeline Management)

  • Qualify leads based on budget, business profile, urgency, and buying intent
  • Categorize leads into Tier 1, Tier 2, or Tier 3 according to established qualification criteria
  • Route qualified opportunities to the appropriate sales representative
  • Escalate hot prospects requiring immediate sales engagement

3. Appointment Setting (Sales Coordination)

  • Schedule discovery calls and sales meetings with qualified prospects
  • Coordinate calendars to maximize appointment availability
  • Confirm appointments and send reminders when necessary
  • Follow up with prospects who miss scheduled meetings

4. CRM & Lead Tracking (Pipeline Accuracy)

  • Maintain accurate lead records and sales pipeline stages
  • Update prospect information after every interaction
  • Ensure notes, tags, and follow-up dates remain current
  • Assist with future migration from spreadsheets into CRM platforms when required

5. Follow-up & Pipeline Ownership (No Lead Left Behind)

  • Execute timely follow-up activities with warm and inactive prospects
  • Re-engage leads that have stalled in the sales process
  • Monitor outstanding actions until appropriate resolution
  • Ensure opportunities are never lost because of delayed communication

6. Social Media Lead Support (Engagement & Conversion)

  • Publish approved marketing content across social media platforms
  • Monitor inbound messages and engagement
  • Respond appropriately to inquiries or endorse qualified prospects to the sales process
  • Track social-generated leads for reporting purposes

7. Reporting & Sales Administration (Visibility)

  • Maintain accurate lead trackers and activity reports
  • Report appointment numbers, lead sources, and qualification outcomes
  • Identify recurring issues affecting lead conversion
  • Maintain organized documentation supporting sales activities

REQUIREMENTS (Non-Negotiable)

  • Previous experience in Sales, Appointment Setting, Inside Sales, or Lead Qualification
  • Female candidates only
  • Fluent verbal and written communication in English
  • Comfortable handling voice-based sales conversations
  • Strong lead qualification and objection-handling skills
  • Experience scheduling appointments and coordinating calendars
  • Familiarity with CRM systems, lead pipelines, and sales processes
  • Strong organizational and time management skills
  • Able to manage multiple conversations while maintaining attention to detail
  • Comfortable working independently with minimal supervision
  • Quick learner with the ability to adapt to new tools and workflows
  • Candidates who avoid proactive follow-up or depend on constant direction are unlikely to succeed in this role

TOOLS

  • Asana
  • Email
  • Google Calendar
  • Google Workspace / Microsoft Office
  • Social Media Platforms (Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, etc.)
  • CRM systems (current spreadsheet tracker with future CRM migration)

WHAT WE VALUE MOST

  • You respond quickly to new sales opportunities.
  • You qualify leads accurately rather than simply forwarding inquiries.
  • You maintain an organized and reliable sales pipeline.
  • You proactively follow up instead of waiting for prospects to respond.
  • You communicate professionally over voice and written channels.
  • You help maximize conversion through consistent execution.
  • You take ownership of every lead until the appropriate next step is completed.

WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

  • Not a customer support position focused solely on answering questions
  • Not a passive administrative role that only schedules meetings
  • Not a social media management position
  • Not a cold-calling role focused exclusively on outbound prospecting
  • Not a role where leads are forwarded without qualification
  • Not suitable for individuals uncomfortable with voice communication or proactive follow-up

POSITION DETAILS

  • Remote
  • Full-time
  • US business hours or overlapping schedule as required
  • Independent contractor engagement
  • Fast-paced sales environment with performance expectations
  • Consistent responsiveness and follow-through are essential

APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS

About American Rivers

American Rivers is a national conservation organization working to make every river clean and healthy for people and wildlife. We combine evidence-based solutions with enduring partnerships to safeguard the 4.4 million miles of rivers and streams that are essential to our nation’s clean drinking water, extraordinary wildlife, and the strength of our communities. For more than 50 years, our staff, supporters, and partners have been driven by a common belief:

Life Depends on Rivers.

The beauty of rivers is that they connect all people and communities – including within our organization. The life experiences, knowledge, innovation, and talent that different people bring to our work provides perspectives, experiences, and competencies which are critical to our effectiveness in protecting wild rivers, restoring damaged rivers, and conserving clean water for people and nature.

Position Summary

The Director is responsible for the strategic ownership, governance, and continuous evolution of the core systems that enable American Rivers to deliver its mission. Serving as the internal product owner for the organization's Conservation Customer Relationship Management (CRM) and project management platforms, this role ensures systems are integrated, scalable, user-centered, and aligned with organizational priorities. The position will lead trainings and provide ongoing coaching to support and enable consistent adoption across the organization. The position will support both day-to-day system administration and longer-term strategy, process design, and continuous improvement. As a highly cross-functional leader, the Director plays a critical role in strengthening the operational infrastructure that allows American Rivers to scale its impact and deliver on its strategic plan.

Principle Responsibilities

Product Strategy and Roadmap

  • Serve as the product owner for the organization's CRM, project management platform, and other core business systems.
  • Develop and execute a multi-year systems roadmap aligned with organizational strategic plan objectives.
  • Prioritize and implement system enhancements, balancing user needs, operational improvements, available resources, and long-term sustainability.
  • Evaluate opportunities to leverage artificial intelligence (AI) and other emerging technologies, and recommend solutions that improve organizational effectiveness and mission delivery.

Systems Governance and Administration

  • Own the configuration, structure, and ongoing maintenance of the CRM and project management platforms
  • Manage user access, templates, system configuration, documentation, and standards.
  • Ensure systems are scalable, user-friendly, secure, and aligned with organizational needs.
  • Partner with Information Technology and organizational leadership to ensure enterprise systems meet security, privacy, and compliance requirements.
  • Conduct periodic reviews of user access, permissions, and system controls.
  • Maintain governance processes that ensure consistent, secure, and responsible management of enterprise systems and organizational data.

Workflow Optimization

  • Partner across departments to improve business processes and translate operational needs into technology solutions.
  • Design standardized workflows, identify automation opportunities, and continuously improve operational efficiency.

Integrations, Data Management and Reporting

  • Ensure seamless integration between CRM, project management tools, and other core systems (e.g., finance, communications, data platforms)
  • Build and maintain automations to streamline workflows and reduce manual effort
  • Establish and uphold data governance practices (data quality, consistency, ownership)
  • Develop and maintain dashboards and reporting to support decision-making

Training and Adoption (Change Management)

  • Lead implementation of new functionality, system upgrades, and releases.
  • Develop training, documentation, and support resources that promote successful adoption and consistent system use.
  • Coordinate testing, user acceptance, communications, and ongoing user support.

Vendor & Technology Management

  • Manage relationships with software vendors and implementation partners.
  • Oversee licensing, product updates, and vendor performance.
  • Support software evaluation, procurement, and future technology implementations.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Education: Associate or Bachelor’s degree required
  • Experience: Systems management, product management or related field, preferably in a nonprofit or mission-driven organization. Hands-on experience managing a CRM
  • Technical: Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint), proficiency with core enterprise software tools (accounting and budgeting software, project management software, and/or CRM), experience managing integrations preferred. American Rivers uses Monday.com as it’s work management tool and is currently in the process to select our Conservation CRM.

Skills:

  • Exceptional organizational skills with strong attention to detail and follow-through.
  • Technical fluency with a variety of software tools.
  • Ability to balance competing needs and evaluate tradeoffs.
  • Strong written and verbal communication
  • Professional discretion and confidentiality.
  • Ability to work across a range of personalities and work styles with staff from all levels of the organization.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a cross-functional team

Core Competencies

  • Systems thinker
  • Resourceful
  • Reliability and integrity
  • Initiative and adaptability
  • Time and project management
  • Collaboration and relationship-building
  • Process orientation and continuous improvement mindset

LOCATION

This position may be located anywhere in the continental United States.

COMPENSATION

American Rivers offers marketable compensation that reflects the qualifications and experience of the selected candidate. Infrastructure Support (NOC)

Client & Internal Coordination

Documentation & Continuous Improvement
  • Maintain a complete incident record in the ticketing system (timeline, evidence, actions, outcomes)

Strong plus

jobs.excerpt: The OpportunityFutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to lead Reclaim, an AI-native denial management and revenue recovery venture.
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

FutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to lead Reclaim, an AI-native denial management and revenue recovery venture. This is a co-founder partnership with meaningful founder equity, not a salaried executive role.

We are entering a $16B+ Total Addressable Market with a gaping $ 7.5B–$10B whitespace, targeting the highly underserved mid-market segment. Currently, 30–40% of denied medical claims go uncontested because practices lack the staff and capital to contest them. This systemic failure leaves between $50,000 and $300,000 in legally earned revenue permanently abandoned at each practice every year.

Reclaim AI resolves denied and aged claims end-to-end, embedding outcome-based contingency pricing—meaning practices pay zero upfront, and we only take a cut of the dollars we successfully recover, for our target ideal customer profile (practices with $80K+ in annual recoverable claims).

Market Context

We didn’t just read market reports; we spent weeks interviewing billing managers, practice owners, revenue cycle leaders at health systems, and even digital operations leaders at major insurance companies. The dysfunction we uncovered is staggering, creating a massive opportunity for a disruptor:

  • The pain is so severe, practices are building their own tech: The frustration of payer opacity is so deep that medical billers are hiring part-time software engineers to build in-house robotic process automation (RPA) scrapers just to check claim statuses.
  • Massive, emotional write-offs: Staff carry immense guilt over these administrative losses. One small-practice assistant admitted, "I feel like we probably had to write off probably close to a million dollars" simply because they couldn't keep up with the manual follow-ups.
  • The "Payer-Side Inversion" Opportunity: We discovered that insurance companies are drowning in the exact same claims dysfunction they generate. One major payer we interviewed reported a backlog of 31,000 contested claims that consumed 80% of their staff's operational capacity, forcing emergency hires just to manage the disputes.
  • The Competition is Distracted: Well-funded Tier-1 competitors are charging $15K+ upfront licensing fees and fighting over enterprise health systems. The competitive window to capture the mid-market with a contingency-priced autonomous agent is wide open.

About FutureSight

FutureSight is a leading venture builder that co-creates world-class software companies with values-driven entrepreneurs from inception to exit. We are a team of founders, operators and designers with experience successfully bringing software to market at scale.

You’ll co-create with a proven studio team, led by John Carbrey (4x entrepreneur, $100M ARR), Krista LaRiviere (3x exited, E&Y Top Women Entrepreneur), Alan Smith (Strategyzer co-founder, $120M in products built), Prathna Ramesh (former MD of Maple Leaf Angels, $275M in follow-on capital), and Johnny Tong (0-to-1 builder, acquired by SAP and Stripe) bring a rare combination of operator exits, institutional investing, and AI product depth.

The Partnership

  • Founder equity with meaningful ownership from inception
  • Pre-seed capital committed by FutureSight for early hires and MVP development, with potential for follow-on funding
  • Venture building resources, including embedded design, engineering, growth, and fundraising support from day one
  • Investor and advisor network across vertical AI and early-stage capital markets
  • A true co-creation model in which you operate as CEO with FutureSight's cross-functional team as your partner

What You’ll Own

As Co-Founder & CEO, you will set the venture's direction and lead its execution.

  • Strategy — Refine the ICP, pricing model, and product positioning
  • Customer Development — Lead pilots with practice owners and revenue cycle leaders, convert them to paid engagements, and build the go-to-market motion
  • Product — Partner with the FutureSight product and engineering team to ship V1 and iterate on user feedback
  • Capital — Lead the seed raise, supported by FutureSight's network and traction
  • Team — Recruit and lead the founding team, and establish the cultural foundation of the company

Co-Founder Profile

  • Domain & Workflow Depth: You have direct exposure to healthcare revenue cycle, medical billing, or denial management. You understand the nuanced differences in denial codes, know why administrative denials (like credentialing gaps) are uniquely painful, and intuitively understand the fragmented systems (e.g., Tebra, eClinicalWorks, Availity) that billers are forced to use
  • Previous founding experience at a venture-backed company
  • Demonstrated success in B2B AI or B2B SaaS go-to-market, including sales and customer engagement
  • Fundraising fluency, with the ability to develop investor narratives and close capital
  • Proven ability to attract, develop, and retain top talent
  • Clear-eyed understanding of the risks and demands of co-founding a venture-backed company

How to Apply

Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.

FutureSight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences.

Swift Navigationis hiring. Let us introduce ourselves. Swift Navigation is changing the way we navigate and understand the world. As the Product Manager for the Mobile Ecosystem, you will own the product definition, roadmap, and ecosystem strategy required to scale Swift’s location capabilities across global mobile platforms.

Working in a tight triad alongside Business Development, Product Marketing, and Engineering you will focus on achieving product-market fit for early-stage mobile initiatives. Your mission is to drive our technology into native, device-level integrations that easily scale across hardware lines.

  • Native Integration Roadmap: Define product requirements for native, device-level activation of Swift’s positioning services via standard mobile operating system location APIs.

At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers and partners are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.

We’re looking for a technically strong workers compensation underwriter to help steer a growing portfolio of WC programs. You’ll be the go-to expert for complex WC referrals and program questions, directly impacting profitability, volatility, and partner experience across our book.

What you’ll do

  • Underwrite complex WC program and large account referrals end-to-end (exposures, losses, structure, and pricing recommendations).
  • Use internal pricing tools, actuarial input, and financial analysis to recommend sound pricing, terms, and structures (e.g., deductibles, large deductibles, dividends, alternative risk).
  • Assess jurisdictional risk (e.g., CA, NY, FL and other challenging venues) and incorporate severity, ALAE, CT, and regulatory nuances into your decisions.
  • Monitor a defined slice of the WC program portfolio (loss ratio, growth, retention, mix), surfacing trends and recommending corrective actions.
  • Serve as a primary WC underwriting contact for assigned program administrators / MGUs and MGAs, shaping submission quality, data, and expectations.
  • Partner with Finance, Actuarial, Claims, Risk Control, and Operations to align on risk quality, loss drivers, collateral, and improvement plans.
  • Model disciplined documentation and communication, including clear system notes and concise leadership-ready summaries.

What you’ll bring

  • 7+ years of workers compensation experience (underwriting or similar), with a strong preference for program, large risk, or high-hazard WC.
  • Proven ability to underwrite complex, multi-state WC risks and to use data, models, and financial information to support your judgment.
  • Strong working knowledge of WC coverages, rating plans, and state-specific requirements; designations such as AU, ARM, CPCU, (or in progress) are a plus.
  • Clear, confident communication skills — able to translate technical insight into practical guidance for leadership, program partners, and brokers.
  • A disciplined, portfolio-minded approach that balances growth, profitability, and volatility.

*This role does not qualify for employer-sponsored work authorization. Nationwide does not participate in the Stem OPT Extension program*

Job Description Summary

Are you a problem solver who can analyze complex risk and find insurance solutions that balance customer needs with business goals? If you can take initiative, use both your analytical and creative abilities to make sound decisions and have a desire to help people solve real challenges, we want to know more about you!

As a Consultant, you'll be responsible for reviewing and analyzing numerous, highly complex lines of business. You'll underwrite individual risk for acceptability, pricing, coverage, terms and conditions. You'll lead in the development and integration of new and existing programs and identify new program opportunities. You will participate in making reinsurance decisions; assist in developing and implementing loss control and risk management strategies. You'll collaborate between business partners for development and implementation of program specific tools (i. e. underwriting guidelines, forms/rate filings, etc) for new programs or modifications to existing programs. You'll communicate program updates to program managers and other business liaisons. In order to succeed, you will need to build and maintain effective relationships with internal business liaisons, external program managers, and other key partners. You will be responsible for the training and mentoring of underwriting team members.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

  • Drives the sales and underwriting relationship for Programs products and services. Provides input and data to help drive and implement strategic underwriting plans. Provides business forecasting related to trends, and profitability within Program vertical. Responsible for achieving established goals for assigned programs.

  • Analyzes program manager relationships/results and recommends corrective actions if necessary. Understands business needs and identifies new business opportunities.

  • Reviews highly complex ((e.g. including D&O, E&O, Employment Practices Liability, Medical Professional Liability, Contractual Liability, Cyber Liability, Shared and Layered Property, General Liability, Excess, auto, Recreation Marine, Energy, Environmental, Inland Marine, Warranty and Workers Compensation) individual risks, programs, or referrals within assigned territory from program managers and declines or accepts business based upon information necessary to make the decision. Some of the risks could be multinational or have alternative arrangements in place that make them unique. Acts as a subject matter expert in analyzing exposures to losses; develops adequate premium charge for the exposure. Determines appropriate endorsements and exclusions to address loss exposures for the insurance contract.

  • Actively engages in discussions with reinsurers per department guidelines verifying the appropriate use of all reinsurance facilities used by the department, including various treaty, semi-automatic and facultative reinsurance. Responsible for compiling data to be provided for reinsurers presentations. Maintains good working relationship with reinsurers.

  • Develops and implements underwriting guidelines, rates, forms, product endorsements and procedures. Assists in the development of department policies and underwriting and standard methodologies.

  • Interacts with various business partners (i.e. claims, actuary, compliance, etc.) to achieve company goals and objectives. Acts as an internal consultant responsible for resolving escalated issues and communicating to business liaisons and external sources regarding program initiatives.

  • Responsible for audits of individual risks/programs for compliance with company guidelines, state regulations and reinsurance conditions. Development and implementation of specific action plans may be required. Responsible for the resolution of advanced complex technical issues.

Travels to existing and potential program manager offices, as required for marketing visits. Frequently entertains Program Managers to market services and ensure strong relationships to write profitable business.

  • Leads in the implementation of all new programs from development of underwriting guidelines, form/rate filings, compliance/regulatory matters, finance, reinsurance, claims, legal, accounting, actuarial and marketing matters to ensure proper program integration.

May Perform other responsibilities as assigned.

Experience: Typically five or more years related experience as a Professional, Financial and/or Specialty lines underwriter. Program leadership experience in professional lines of business is preferred. Some experience in the technical aspects of data management, imaging and procedures and processes helpful.

Knowledge, Abilities and Skills: Demonstrated knowledge of Professional, Financial, and/or Specialty lines underwriting policies, practices and procedures, insurance law and underwriting marketing principles and techniques. Strong understanding of financial documents, financial analysis, investments, market conditions essential. Legal knowledge related to insurance, contract and business law preferred. Understanding of employment principles and practices.

Must possess strong verbal and written communication skills to interact with internal/external business partners at all levels. Must have skills to influence and negotiate with internal/external business partners at all levels. Must have the ability to manage large programs; develop and apply innovative approaches to program initiatives and problem solutions. Proven ability to analyze and interpret mathematical, statistical and logical data, and evaluate its reliability and significance. Must have project and process management skills. jobs.description:
Job Purpose The Senior Cloud Security Engineer will design, implement, and maintain security controls across our multi-cloud environment, with a particular emphasis on securing AI/ML workloads and leveraging AI-driven security tooling. The Senior Cloud Security Engineer will serve as a technical leader, partnering with engineering, application development, and DevOps teams to embed security into every stage of the cloud and AI development lifecycle.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Design and implement secure cloud architecture across AWS and Azure, including identity, network security, encryption, and key management
  • Implement cloud-native logging, monitoring, and threat detection to improve visibility and incident response
  • Build Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Bicep), Policy-as-Code, and automated compliance controls
  • Implement and enhance Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM), Cloud Workload Protection (CWPP), and CNAPP capabilities
  • Conduct threat modeling, security architecture reviews, and risk assessments for cloud services and applications
  • Design and secure AI/ML environments, including MLOps pipelines, model security, inference endpoints, and AI governance
  • Assess and mitigate AI-specific threats, including prompt injection, model poisoning, adversarial attacks, and data leakage
  • Partner with engineering and data science teams to implement secure-by-design and privacy-preserving controls for regulated data
  • Develop automated detections, SOAR playbooks, and AI-driven threat hunting capabilities
  • Lead technical response to cloud and AI security incidents, including forensic analysis and remediation
  • Design and implement security controls supporting HIPAA, HITRUST, PCI DSS, SOC 2, NIST CSF, and NIST AI RMF requirements
  • Support technical readiness, evidence collection, and remediation activities for security audits and compliance assessments
  • Develop and maintain cloud security standards, technical guidance, and AI governance documentation
  • Support enterprise risk management and vendor security assessments
  • Integrate security throughout the DevSecOps lifecycle, including application, container, and secrets management
  • Develop security metrics, communicate technical risks to stakeholders, and recommend continuous security improvements
  • Mentor junior engineers and champion security best practices across engineering teams
  • Other duties as assigned
  • Use, protect and disclose patients’ protected health information (PHI) only in accordance with Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) standards
  • Understand and comply with Information Security and HIPAA policies and procedures at all times
  • Limit viewing of PHI to the absolute minimum as necessary to perform assigned duties

Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent required
  • 6+ years of experience in information security, with at least 4 years focused on cloud security engineering
  • Deep hands-on expertise in both AWS and Microsoft Azure, including native security services (e.g., AWS GuardDuty, Security Hub, IAM Identity Center; Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Sentinel, Entra ID)
  • Strong knowledge of IAM, zero trust architecture, network security, encryption, and secrets management in cloud environments
  • Practical experience securing AI/ML systems or LLM-based applications, or demonstrable working knowledge of AI security frameworks (OWASP LLM Top 10, MITRE ATLAS, NIST AI RMF)
  • Proficiency in at least one scripting/programming language (Python preferred) and infrastructure-as-code tooling
  • Experience with container and orchestration security (Docker, Kubernetes, EKS/AKS)
  • Solid understanding of DevSecOps practices and CI/CD security integration
  • Hands-on experience supporting compliance programs such as HIPAA, HITRUST CSF, PCI DSS, and SOC 2 in cloud environments, including audit evidence and control implementation
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite
  • Strong interpersonal skills, ability to communicate well at all levels of the organization
  • Strong problem solving and creative skills and the ability to exercise sound judgment and make decisions based on accurate and timely analyses
  • High level of integrity and dependability with a strong sense of urgency and results oriented
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills required

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) in addition to AWS and Azure
  • Experience deploying or securing MLOps platforms (SageMaker, Vertex AI, Azure ML, Databricks, Kubeflow)
  • Familiarity with AI-driven security platforms and building custom detections using ML techniques
  • Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, HCISPP, CCSFP (HITRUST), AWS Security Specialty, Azure Security Engineer (AZ-500), GCP Professional Cloud Security Engineer, or GIAC certifications
  • Prior experience in healthcare, health tech, or revenue cycle management environments handling PHI at scale
  • Experience with red teaming or adversarial testing of AI systems
  • Knowledge of data privacy regulations as they apply to AI training data and model outputs, particularly de-identification standards under HIPAA (Safe Harbor and Expert Determination)
  • Contributions to security communities, open-source tooling, or published research

Working Conditions

  • Travel may be required for training, conferences, etc.
  • Must possess a smart-phone or electronic device capable of downloading applications, for multifactor authentication and security purposes
  • Physical Demands: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to move around the work area; Sit; perform manual tasks; operate tools and other office equipment such as computer, computer peripherals and telephones; extend arms; kneel; talk and hear
  • Mental Demands: The employee must be able to follow directions, collaborate with others, and handle stress
  • Work Environment: The noise level in the work environment is usually minimal
